runners.name: Princling
runners.spotlight: Sole win was at 1-4 in a novice race but competitive every time, in valuable handicaps over 1m and 1m2f on last two outings (good to firm); latest was at Royal Ascot (10-1) where he had the widest draw and mostly raced widest but kept on in fifth of 16 (Evanesco nearly 2l behind in seventh); that did not look the ideal run of the race and he's probably set for better still.
runners.comment: Had the widest draw and mostly raced widest when fifth of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m2f)

runners.name: Archers Bay
runners.spotlight: Improved form over 1m2f at the other Newmarket track on his first two starts this season, winning a handicap (on good) and third of five in a Listed race (good to firm); the Derby Italiano on heavy ground last time did not work out but he returns to a handicap on what looks a pretty good mark.
runners.comment: Derby Italiano on heavy ground did not work out; back to a handicap on a pretty good mark

runners.name: Heraldry
runners.spotlight: Got up close home in a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in April on reappearance; a gap opened at the right time that day but it didn't in a novice at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May and Decade Of Time got first run before this one found room from just inside the final 1f; left the impression of unfinished business that day and now has a 10lb pull with his admittedly promising rival; failed to get into 1m2f Royal Ascot handicap as a reserve; dam was 11.6f Lingfield Oaks Trial winner; major interest.
runners.comment: Left the impression of unfinished business behind Decade Of Time at Windsor; has 10lb pull

runners.name: Laureate Crown
runners.spotlight: This step up in trip is not sure to suit but he arrived late on the scene to win handicaps at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) and Sandown (1m, good) on his first two outings this year and came from last in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, finishing 12th of 30 overall but second of those who had raced far side; probably remains in form.
runners.comment: New trip is not sure to suit; probably remained in form with his 1m run at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Decade Of Time
runners.spotlight: Shaped well at Newbury on debut before winning an 11-runner novice at Windsor (1m, good to firm; cosily) in May and a three-runner novice at Nottingham (1m, soft) in June; Windsor runner-up Heraldry now has a big pull in the weights but this one is lightly raced and promising, and he shapes as if 1m2f can help on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Two 1m novice wins; promising and he shapes as if 1m2f can help on this handicap debut

runners.name: Evanesco
runners.spotlight: Improved form in 1m2f handicaps at the other Newmarket course on his first two starts this term, bossing a five-runner race (good to firm) impressively on second occasion; doing the same off this 8lb higher mark in 16-runner race at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm; 12-1) wasn't possible but he led entering straight until over 1f out and wasn't at all discredited in seventh (Princling fifth); could get run of the race this time and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Not at all discredited at Royal Ascot (1m2f); could get run of the race up front today

races.race_name: Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes (Sponsored By Ultimate Provence) (Group 2) (Fillies)

runners.name: Senorita Bonita
runners.spotlight: 900,000gns breeze-up buy who got up on the line to justify odds-on favouritism on debut at Nottingham (5f, good) last month, and she took a step forward with her 2l second of 27 in the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) a fortnight later; there's every chance that 6f will suit and her stable won this in 2024; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Won on debut and second in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot; firmly in calculations

runners.name: Libertango
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns breeze-up buy who won at 4-1 on her debut at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May and finished strongly from a tough position to win the Group 3 Albany Stakes at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago, ahead of a runner-up who has since won a Group 2; leading claims.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 in the Albany at Royal Ascot; form has been franked and she has leading claims

runners.name: Ruby Moon
runners.spotlight: Her dam is from a classy family and this filly came well clear with a fair yardstick to win cosily at 4-1 on last month's debut at Carlisle (6f, good to firm); others have far more substance to their form but she could have plenty more left in the tank and Ryan Moore rides.
runners.comment: Cosy debut win at Carlisle; others have stronger form but she should have more to offer

runners.name: Jolivette
runners.spotlight: Well backed when winning by a neck on debut on the other Newmarket course (6f, good) in May; then beaten about 8l by Libertango when ninth of 25 in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm; Acclamation Star tenth); raced freely in a share of the lead last time and this half-sister to Group 2 winner Jonquil retains potential if able to settle better; not written off.
runners.comment: Won on debut then soundly beaten at Royal Ascot, but retains potential if settling better

runners.name: Alwaysanangel
runners.spotlight: Wore this tongue-tie on debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good) last Wednesday when coming from the rear to win by 3l at 15-2; this is a much tougher test of her credentials but she wasn't fully extended and it remains to be seen where her limitations lie; from a leading Irish yard; interesting.
runners.comment: Takes a leap in grade but she impressed on last Wednesday's debut at Fairyhouse

runners.name: Troublesome Guest
runners.spotlight: Promising third on debut on the other Newmarket course (6f, good) in May then midfield in the Listed Windsor Castle (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot, having made the running; considerable improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Third on debut and midfield in Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot; lots of improvement needed

runners.name: Acclamation Star
runners.spotlight: Having been outpaced, she rallied to win with something to spare at 17-2 on her debut at Bath (5.7f, firm) in May; could be capable of better than she showed when tenth of 25 at 66-1 in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) but she has 8l to find with the winner Libertango.
runners.comment: Won with something to spare on debut at Bath but 8l behind Libertango at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Etonnante
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Group 2 runner-up Eponine and sent off the 5-6 favourite when winning readily on debut at Ripon (6f, good) in May, the front two clear; it was always the plan to miss Royal Ascot and she's well regarded by her trainer, who has won two of the last six runnings; entered in the Lowther and Moyglare; could give a good account up in grade.
runners.comment: Ready win on debut at Ripon in May; always the plan to miss Royal Ascot; well regarded

runners.name: Wine Dark Sea
runners.spotlight: Won three of his five handicaps, including warm events on good to firm at Ascot (1m4f) and Carlisle (1m3f) in his two starts this season; firmly in charge on first occasion and absolutely hacked up when 5-6 favourite in the latter 16 days ago; shoulders a 6lb penalty today, whereas his mark for future engagements is 11lb higher still; that suggests he wins today if he stays this new trip, and the dam being sister to a 1m5f-2m winner gives plenty of encouragement; deservedly a hot favourite.
runners.comment: Won two warm events this term (1m4f/1m3f) and hacked up on latest; thrown in with penalty

runners.name: Goblet Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Second run after wind surgery saw him better than ever back on turf for a clearcut win in 12-runner race on the other Newmarket track (1m6f, good to firm) when last seen nearly ten weeks ago; 7lb rise demands better still but he's a regular Flat winner who needs respect.
runners.comment: Clearcut win at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) in early May when last seen; 7lb rise

runners.name: Valedictory
runners.spotlight: All the rage in the betting for his first two starts this season, with the line coming a touch too soon on first occasion (1m2f); rather muted on the step up to 1m4f behind Wine Dark Sea at Ascot (good to firm) next time but the combination of 1m6f and first-time headgear worked a treat at Goodwood (good) seven weeks ago when he travelled much the best on his way to a tidy win; 5lb rise may well underestimate what he had in the tank.
runners.comment: 5lb rise may well underestimate what he had in the tank when winning at Goodwood (1m6f)

runners.name: Pole Star
runners.spotlight: Respectable third to Goblet Of Fire on the other Newmarket track (1m6f, good to firm) in May in a first-time visor; perhaps any beneficial effect from the headgear has worn off, as he ran poorly on latest start, but he is now 1lb below his last winning mark (from last July) and the visor is removed.
runners.comment: 1lb below his last winning mark (from last July) and the recent visor is removed
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Roaring Legend
runners.spotlight: Fourth in this race last year off the same mark; fine efforts when runner-up in February on first two starts (2m, AW) since rejoining this yard, but reportedly made a respiratory noise next time and, following his third wind operation, he was a soundly beaten outsider in Listed race four weeks ago; others seem more solid.
runners.comment: Fourth in this race last year off the same mark; questions to answer after last two starts

runners.name: Asgard's Captain
runners.spotlight: Seen mostly at up to 1m4f, over which he delivered a telling late challenge on the other Newmarket track in May; while that looked encouraging for longer trips, his one attempt at 1m6f (on soft last July) and two at 2m (last two Northumberland Plates) saw him well beaten; that's not conclusive proof that he won't stay 1m6f but it leaves his stamina unproven.
runners.comment: Delivered a telling late challenge at Newmarket (1m4f) in May; stamina unproven for this

runners.name: Beylerbeyi
runners.spotlight: Tricky to settle and is held up in rear; won the Cesarewitch at Newmarket (2m2f, good to firm; 9lb higher today) last October and had some very solid AW form over 1m2f-2m this year; back to near his best when eighth of 20 at Royal Ascot (2m4f) but he needs to hit a new high if he's to win this.
runners.comment: Back near his best when eighth of 20 at Royal Ascot (2m4f) but needs to hit a new high

runners.name: Majestic
runners.spotlight: Won the 1m1f Cambridgeshire at Newmarket in September 2022 but his solitary win since was in Bahrain (1m2f) in January 2025; went close over 1m4f last August and runner-up over 11.4f at Windsor 13 days ago, but this trip (well beaten trying 1m5f once last year) is doubtful territory.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 11.4f at Windsor 13 days ago but this trip is doubtful territory

runners.name: Oneforthegutter
runners.spotlight: Second in this race in 2024 and won it last year (good to firm); now he has a 4lb lower mark than last year; that's having failed to finish in the first six in any of his seven races since, but at least his latest start was better than reappearance and it's not unheard of for runners from this stable to surge back to form.
runners.comment: 2nd in this race in 2024; won it last year and is 4lb lower today, having been below form

runners.name: Real Dream
runners.spotlight: Third in this race last year off 3lb higher; competitive only once (Saudi Arabia in February) from six starts this year and there's been no win for very nearly three years, so he's far from being the percentage call.
runners.comment: Third in this last year off 3lb higher; competitive only once from six starts this year

races.race_name: Tattersalls Sceptre Sessions Falmouth Stakes (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Precise
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming favourite in the 1,000 Guineas on reappearance but has left that behind with subsequent wins in the Irish 1,000 Guineas at the Curragh (1m, good) and the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm); after a slow start last time she was trapped three wide but still won in convincing fashion, and she's a leading contender in her bid for a fifth Group 1 win.
runners.comment: Four Group 1 wins, the latest the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot; leading contender

runners.name: Blue Bolt
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Group 1 Sun Chariot on the other Newmarket course last October (1m, good) and this lightly raced 4yo made it two from two for this year when winning the Group 2 Duke Of Cambridge at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month, travelling well to beat Jancis by just under 2l; that latest performance suggests she's capable of landing a Group 1 prize; key player.
runners.comment: Group 2 win at Royal Ascot last month and she should be capable of landing a Group 1 prize

runners.name: Balantina
runners.spotlight: 2yo campaign concluded with a win in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf (1m, firm); reappeared with respectable fifth to Precise in the Group 1 Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month, when she got warm beforehand and weakened late on; could show the benefit of that outing and pose a bigger threat today; trainer won this in 2024 with Porta Fortuna.
runners.comment: Breeders' Cup winner last October; returned with respectable fifth; could build on that
runners.owner: S I Weston/Medallion Racing LLC/Reeves T'bred/ L A McNulty

runners.name: Jancis
runners.spotlight: 5yo who has been a big improver this year, winning the Group 2 Dahlia Stakes on the other Newmarket course (1m1f, good to firm) on her reappearance and producing a career best when second to Blue Bolt in the Group 2 Duke Of Cambridge at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month, beaten just under 2l under a 3lb penalty; they reoppose off level weights and she's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Second to Blue Bolt at Royal Ascot and 3lb better off today; not ruled out

runners.name: Evolutionist
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden winner last August who was third to Precise in the Group 1 Fillies' Mile in October; returned with Group 3 win at Longchamp (1m, good) in April and runner-up in the 1,000 Guineas (1m, good to firm) next time, faring best of those who raced on the far side (led that group); failed to settle and weakened when soundly beaten in the Prix de Diane (10.5f, good to firm) last time; drops back in trip but improvement is needed to win this.
runners.comment: 1,000 Guineas runner-up who drops back to 1m, but improvement is needed to win this

runners.name: Venetian Lace
runners.spotlight: Second to Precise in the Group 1 Fillies' Mile last October (good; no match for the winner) and returned with fine third in the 1,000 Guineas (1m, good to firm; Fillies' Mile third Evolutionist in second); failed to settle when tailed off over 1m4f in the Oaks last month (when reportedly unsuited by the slow ground); drops back in trip but with something to find.
runners.comment: Third in the Guineas; tailed off in the Oaks (slow ground excuse); has something to find
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Venosa
runners.spotlight: She's shown ability but nothing like enough to suggest she'll be a contender today; 0-6 and likely to be a pacemaker for her stablemate Precise.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden who is likely to be a pacemaker for her stablemate Precise
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

races.race_name: Weatherbys Banking Group British EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Acting Lady
runners.spotlight: 5-6 favourite when very close third of three on debut over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago, travelling smoothly into the lead before being overhauled; she could improve for that run and her top trainer won this last year with her half-sister Crimson Rose, who also finished third on her debut.
runners.comment: Travelled best when very close 3rd of three over C&D on debut; could improve for that run

runners.name: Pure Majesty
runners.spotlight: 300,000gns yearling; eighth foal; State Of Rest half-sister to six winners including Sky Majesty (6f, including 2yo Group 2 for connections), Democracy Dilemma (multiple 5f including 2yo/Listed), Angel Alexander (5f/6f; RPR 111) and Mighty Spirit (5f 2yo; 94); dam Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner; in top hands and bred to be a talented 2yo; firmly in calculations on debut.
runners.comment: 300,000gns yearling; in top hands and bred to be a talented 2yo; firmly in calculations

runners.name: Desert Smoke
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling, 80,000gns breeze-up 2yo; second foal; dam 5f winner (RPR 80), half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Aleezdancer, out of 7f Listed winner; trainer is enjoying a productive season with his 2yos and this Havana Grey newcomer could have a part to play.
runners.comment: 80,000gns breeze-up 2yo; trainer having good season with 2yos; could have a part to play

runners.name: Sorrengail
runners.spotlight: First foal; unraced dam is closely related to connections' 6.5f-1m Group 1/Grade 1 winner Space Blues and 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Dance To The Music, half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Shuruq, out of 7f Group 2 winner; William Buick rides once-raced stablemate Acting Lady but it will be no surprise if this Wootton Bassett newcomer runs a big race.
runners.comment: Unraced dam closely related to Space Blues; Buick on Acting Lady, but she could run well

runners.name: Desert Sands
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten sixth of 12 at 16-1 on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) but performed respectably when 9l 12th of 25 in the Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm; 250-1); not ruled out back down in grade.
runners.comment: Respectable in midfield at Royal Ascot on second run and not ruled out back down in grade

runners.name: She's Nice
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns breeze-up 2yo; fifth foal; Blue Point half-sister to winners Aragon Castle (7f 2yo/1m; RPR 99) and West Suffolk (Bahraini 1m1f-1m3f); dam unplaced at 6f/10.5f in France, from useful family; one to watch in the betting but other newcomers appeal more on paper.
runners.comment: 75,000gns breeze-up 2yo; one to watch in betting but other newcomers appeal more on paper

runners.name: Jessica Lily
runners.spotlight: 215,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Blue Point half-sister to winners El Bodon (6f AW including 2yo; RPR 106) and Pillow Talk (5f 2yo Listed); dam 5f 2yo winner (88), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Sands Of Mali; trainer won this in 2023 with subsequent Group 3 winner; could give a good account on debut.
runners.comment: 215,000gns yearling; trainer won this in 2023 with subsequent Group 3 winner Sacred Angel

runners.name: Sierra Belle
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Frankel sister to powerful connections' 7f AW 2yo winner Brave Mission (RPR 96); dam 6f 2yo winner (98), half-sister to winners including Juliet Foxtrot (US 8.5f Grade 1) and Juliet Sierra (6f 2yo Group 3); could have a very bright future and she's one to be interested in on debut.
runners.comment: Frankel sister to 7f 2yo winner Brave Mission (RPR 96); one to be interested in on debut

runners.name: Speed Of Sound
runners.spotlight: £70,000 yearling; third foal; closely related to 6f 2yo winner Brisk Symphony (RPR 85), half-sister to Italian 6f winner Naniska Park (including 2yo); dam unraced half-sister to winners Luna Mission (6f 2yo) and Cryptonite (5.7f-1m), out of Listed-placed 5f/6f winner; trainer's 2yos have been running well and this Sioux Nation debutante might not be far away.
runners.comment: £70,000 yearling; trainer's 2yos running well; might not be far away on debut

runners.name: Hout Bay
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros foal, 40,000gns yearling, 150,000euros breeze-up 2yo; sixth foal; Bayside Boy half-sister to winners Klopp Of The Kop (7f/7.4f; RPR 76), Imperial Eight (7f/7.5f; 69) and Burning Kiss (Italian 1m/1m1f); dam Italian Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner (93); trainer isn't known for first-time-out 2yo winners but the stable is in fine form; the betting may be informative.
runners.comment: 150,000euros breeze-up 2yo; stable is in fine form and the betting may be informative
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Tansy Lane
runners.spotlight: 14-1 when sixth of ten on debut at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago, beaten just under 4l having made the running; she has a useful pedigree and is open to improvement, but needs a sizeable step forward.
runners.comment: Useful pedigree; debut 6th gives her something to build on but needs sizeable step forward

runners.name: Never Just A Dream
runners.spotlight: Better known for AW exploits and has had few chances on turf, running his best race in this sphere when fourth of eight at Newbury (6f, good to soft; stable debut after 223 days off) four weeks ago; potentially well treated and he's interesting with that run behind him.
runners.comment: More to prove on turf but stable debut was promising; he's potentially very well treated

runners.name: Our Cody
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-10 but she's fairly useful and has performed well in 5f contests (handicap/Listed) at Sandown this term; played up beforehand and withdrawn from an intended engagement at York two weeks ago; Ryan Moore booked and she could do better yet.
runners.comment: Just 1-10 but she has run two solid races this year; Ryan Moore booked; one to consider

runners.name: Rhythm N Hooves
runners.spotlight: Had a rare off day in the Dash at Epsom but quickly back on track with a close third at Windsor (5f good to firm) 18 days ago; unlikely to be far away off the same mark.
runners.comment: Not beaten far at Windsor 18 days ago and should give another good account off same mark

runners.name: Rapper's Delight
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo; yet to win a handicap but he's finished runner-up on both turf and AW, with Sunday's close call at Southwell (5f, AW) representing improvement; ahead of the handicapper and holds obvious claims; stable also run Twilight Calls.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but looks favourably treated; near miss on Sunday; high on the list

runners.name: Emperor Spirit
runners.spotlight: First run for Michael Keady when winning this race 12 months ago off a 3lb higher mark; two good runs on fast ground this year (below par on slower going in the Epsom Dash) and he's likely to make another bold bid.
runners.comment: 3lb lower than when winning this race in 2025; arrives in good form; shortlisted

runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: His two wins have come in small-field affairs but he gave a good account of himself in the 3yo Dash at Epsom five weeks ago; effective on fast ground; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Two wins in small fields; ran fair race at Epsom last month but a big personal best needed

runners.name: Star Chorus
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW earlier in the year, winning twice at Southwell (5f/6f); best effort since returned to turf came at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago when a close fifth of ten; more required back up in class.
runners.comment: In good form on AW early in year, winning twice; this summer's turf runs need bettering

runners.name: Underwriter
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Ayr (6f) in novice/maiden company last term either side of a heavy defeat in the Coventry Stakes; well beaten in two handicaps this year and sold out of Archie Watson's stable for 4,600gns last week; plenty to prove and stable has more obvious claims with Emperor Spirit.
runners.comment: Well beaten in 2 handicaps for Archie Watson this year; sold 4,600gns last week; opposable

runners.name: Rosario
runners.spotlight: Of interest from a handicapping perspective, 3lb lower than when a close third in last season's Portland at Doncaster (5.6f, good); not beaten far into fifth at Windsor 18 days ago; not easy to win with but likely to give a good account.
runners.comment: Not easy to win with but on a good mark and not beaten far last time; each-way shout

runners.name: Tatterstall
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; two good runs back from her eight-month absence, headed close home at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; that form is working out well and he has earned the 2lb rise; bold bid can be expected.
runners.comment: Two good runs this season, with latest second working out well; solid claims up 2lb

runners.name: Rocking Ends
runners.spotlight: C&D record reads 131, the defeat coming behind Emperor Spirit in this race last year; 5lb lower than for his last win and although he's yet to really shine this year, the booking of Oisin Murphy is notable; contender with frequent cheekpieces now discarded.
runners.comment: C&D record reads 131; good mark on 2025 best and Oisin Murphy booked; contender

runners.name: Twilight Calls
runners.spotlight: Formerly high class; ended a long losing run at Sandown (5f, good) last month when visored for the first time; beaten at odds-on at Yarrmouth six days later; another 3lb higher today but not handicapped out of things.
runners.comment: Not the force of old but revived by a visor on last two starts; one to consider

runners.name: Toastmaster
runners.spotlight: Changed stables this spring and he was a close third on his first two runs for the yard (7f, good/good to firm) before a deserved win at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month, getting off the mark at the tenth attempt with Flight Control and Three Non Blondes close up; respected up just 2lb.
runners.comment: Posted a deserved first win at Doncaster last month and he's respected up just 2lb
runners.owner: Follow The Majer Partners & S Herrington

runners.name: Sierra Sands
runners.spotlight: 7f 2yo winner who kept on well to win in a small field here (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; this is more competitive but he did it cosily under Ryan Moore, who remains on board, and the return to 7f may be a plus.
runners.comment: Did it cosily under Ryan Moore over 6f here recently and the return to 7f may be a plus

runners.name: Lion Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-4 for the year when winning at Leicester (7f, good to firm) in April and bounced back from a lesser run on soft ground with another win at Sandown last month (7f, good; Kimbara second); had just half a length to spare but he had to wait for a clear run and all of his wins have been by narrow margins; could still be ahead of the handicapper up 3lb.
runners.comment: Four wins from his six starts this year and he could still be ahead of the handicapper

runners.name: Calling A Star
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in February and returned to form with a gutsy handicap win at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month, keeping on well; pulled hard and weakened over 7f two starts ago but she might have potential at this trip if she settles.
runners.comment: Kept on well to win over 6f at Windsor; might have potential at 7f if she settles
runners.owner: A Smith, J Henwood & Star Amusements

runners.name: Three Non Blondes
runners.spotlight: Two wins from her four starts for Karl Burke and she was a close third of 13 on stable debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; behind two of these) three weeks ago, having led; in the mix if confirming that promise.
runners.comment: Close third on stable debut at Doncaster and in the mix if confirming that promise

runners.name: Flight Control
runners.spotlight: All four starts at Doncaster; 80-1 win on debut in April (6f, good to firm) and respectable efforts on next two starts before close second to Toastmaster last month in his first handicap (7f, good to firm); a possible.
runners.comment: Close second at Doncaster three weeks ago in his first handicap and he's a possible

runners.name: Angel Gabriel
runners.spotlight: Beaten 4l by Sierra Sands when fourth of five at 100-30 for his handicap and seasonal debut here (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; however, he may have needed that run and this well-bred sort, who won a 6f AW novice last December, retains potential for his top trainer; could go well.
runners.comment: Held on recent reappearance here but may have needed the run; well bred; retains potential

runners.name: Daretobedifferent
runners.spotlight: Won at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in May before respectable third of seven at Lingfield (1m1f, soft); hampered at the start when she flopped here (1m, good to firm) a fortnight and she's much better than that, but she needs to bounce back with a career best if she's to come out on top.
runners.comment: Excuse when flopping here a fortnight ago but she needs to bounce back with a career best

runners.name: Kimbara
runners.spotlight: Improved form when second to Lion Of Mali on handicap debut at Sandown (7f, good) last month and again went close when third at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; a first win is unlikely to be far away; contender.
runners.comment: Went close last month in his first two handicaps; a first win is unlikely to be far away

runners.name: Aqua Bear
runners.spotlight: 7f AW maiden winner who returned to form when third at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) recently; the drop back to 7f could help and he has a chance.
runners.comment: Back to form when third at Carlisle recently and the drop back to 7f could help; chance

runners.name: Ice Cube
runners.spotlight: It's possible that 7f on fast ground will represent his ideal conditions, and he's not had that combination in any of his four handicap starts this season; goes back up in trip today but from 2lb out of the handicap and others arrive with more pressing claims.
runners.comment: These conditions could suit but 2lb out of the handicap; others have more pressing claims

races.race_name: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap

runners.name: Canvas
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 1m handicaps last season, the last of them at this track off a 2lb higher mark; his reappearance at Newmarket (1m, good) in May was encouraging but he flopped at Carlisle 16 days ago when good to firm ground was put forward as an excuse; the going could be an issue back at 7f here too.
runners.comment: On a fair mark and effective at the track but others look stronger back at 7f

runners.name: Northern Express
runners.spotlight: High-class handicapper at 7f/1m; winless since landing a valuable 7f handicap at Ascot in July 2024 but he is now 7lb lower and he retains plenty of ability; should be sharper with last month's reappearance behind him; bold bid expected as he attempts to win this race for a second time.
runners.comment: 2023 winner of this race; on losing run but retains ability and down in weights; chance

runners.name: Andesite
runners.spotlight: Yet to win for new connections but he has run stormers here (7f/1m, both good ground) on his last two starts, bumping into a handicap blot on the first occasion and going down by just a neck two weeks ago; slow starts are a problem though and he will need things to go his way; cheekpieces now join the tongue tie.
runners.comment: Good seconds over 7f and 1m here on last two runs; slow starts are a problem though

runners.name: Son
runners.spotlight: Did best of the prominent racers when third of 19 over C&D last month, splitting Andesite and Lir Speciale in the process; not so good dropped into a Class 4 at Musselburgh ten days ago; minor placing perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Ran well in big field here last month but not quite so good in a lower grade ten days ago

runners.name: Angel Hunter
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m handicap at Lingfield on Good Friday off this mark; another solid effort when a close sixth at Newmarket (1m, good) three weeks ago; more needed to come out on top here.
runners.comment: 1m AW win off this mark on Good Friday; solid 6th at Newmarket latest; this demands more

runners.name: Our Havana
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 quietly but that resulted in a drop in the weights and he bounced back to form when pipping Lir Speciale over C&D four weeks ago; that was his first run after a wind operation and he retains handicapping scope despite a 3lb rise; drawn widest.
runners.comment: Winning return from wind op when pipping Lir Speciale over C&D last month; 3lb rise fine

runners.name: Tilted Kilt
runners.spotlight: Both his wins have come on AW but he handles turf, albeit best grass runs have come on good going; two disappointing efforts since his Southwell win in April and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Handles turf but perhaps doesn't want it too fast; not at best on last two starts

runners.name: Pellitory
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f conditions event at Newmarket last April and paid the price with the handicapper as a result; left James Owen for 52,000gns last October; well beaten in both runs for David O'Meara but in ultra-competitive Ascot handicaps; sneaking down the weights and the type to pop up at some point soon.
runners.comment: Stiff tasks in two red-hot Ascot handicaps for new yard; edging down weights; interesting

runners.name: Rare Change
runners.spotlight: In fine form last spring, winning three times including over C&D; cheekpieces returned at Goodwood last month and he recorded a narrow soft-ground success; 2lb rise shouldn't handicap him out of things and faster ground should be beneficial.
runners.comment: C&D winner last May; game effort on soft at Goodwood latest; 2lb rise not beyond him
runners.owner: Mrs J Woods And K Lawrence

runners.name: Quest For Fun
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner and has also run with distinction in defeat here on numerous occasions; retains plenty of ability despite his advancing years but he would be better suited by slower conditions.
runners.comment: This C&D brings out the best in him but he would appeal more under slower conditions

runners.name: Wild Nature
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first turf win; fair mark judged on his AW best but neither start this year suggests he is the answer today.
runners.comment: Promise on turf but both wins on AW; needs to leave this year's form well behind

runners.name: Milford
runners.spotlight: Beaten 16 times since his winning 2yo debut but there have been several good runs along the way; two midfield finishes in good handicaps this summer; edging down the weights and he should be popping up soon.
runners.comment: No win since 2yo debut but on a good mark and he should be popping up soon

runners.name: Lir Speciale
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of heavy-ground wins at Doncaster (7f); better form in defeat this year, placed in good C&D handicaps (good ground) in consecutive days last month; has won on fast ground and his connections took this race in 2024; needs serious consideration.
runners.comment: Solid placed efforts in C&D handicaps in consecutive days last month; in the mix again

runners.name: Lord Roxby
runners.spotlight: He has one good 7f run to his name but his wins have come over sprint trips, the latest in a big-field handicap here (6f, good) in May; two solid efforts have followed but may prove vulnerable to stronger stayers.
runners.comment: 6f win here in May and two solid runs since; 7f perhaps further than ideal
runners.owner: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover

runners.name: Yanifer
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; just 1lb higher than for last August's win at Chester (7.6f, good to firm); effective over C&D and last month's reappearance should have sharpened him up; suspicion he will prove vulnerable to younger rivals here though.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit, feasibly weighted and should be sharper for comeback; still vulnerable

runners.name: Goldmoyne
runners.spotlight: His progress for James Owen has been quite a story, winning a 6f handicap at Newcastle in December off a 40lb lower mark; fine second-place finishes on his last two runs and still seems to be improving; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Flourished for James Owen and no signs of slowing down; should be involved again

runners.name: Morte Point
runners.spotlight: Improved for a step up to 7f last season; made a slow start to this campaign but he had a wind operation in June and returned to form with a win at Chepstow (7f, good to firm; blinkered first time) last week; penalty in a much stronger race asks a stiffer question.
runners.comment: Blinkers worked the oracle at Chepstow last week; 5lb penalty in a much deeper race here

runners.name: King Casper
runners.spotlight: None too consistent for Hugo Palmer last year but he is well treated on his best form; sold for 24,000gns last October; likely best watched back at 7f after 287 days off.
runners.comment: Inconsistent for Hugo Palmer last year; sold 24,000gns since latest; best watched
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner

runners.name: Croupier
runners.spotlight: Top handicap form for the Crisfords in 2023, including at York; absent for 1038 days prior to his Haydock return in April and duly well beaten; better run here at the Dante meeting and he should be at concert pitch now.
runners.comment: Retains ability back from his mammoth absence; should be at concert pitch now

runners.name: Flora Of Bermuda
runners.spotlight: Won this on good to soft in 2024 and also close second in C&D Group 2 on good to firm last year; reappeared with Listed win at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in May; eased off as if amiss (got upset in stalls) in Royal Ascot Group 1 since but turns out again three weeks later and will have a big say if back near her best.
runners.comment: Something not right at Ascot latest but really smart on day, including 2024 win in this

runners.name: Spicy Marg
runners.spotlight: Listed winner at Newmarket (6f, good) last October; beaten 4.5l into third by Venetian Sun in the Sandy Lane at Haydock on good to soft in May but got a lot closer that rival on quicker ground in the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot, going down by only a head for a big career best, with reopposing Fitzella fifth; the one to beat.
runners.comment: The one to beat here after her near miss in Group 1 at Royal Ascot last month

runners.name: First Instinct
runners.spotlight: Won a Cork Listed race (5.5f, good) and Newbury Group 3 (5f, good to soft) in 2025 but hasn't got close to that form in two 5f starts this year, albeit it was a Royal Ascot Group 1 latterly; won over 6f on good to firm at the start of her career.
runners.comment: Listed/Group 3 wins in 2025 but hasn't found that form in 2 outings this year

runners.name: Royal Fixation
runners.spotlight: Leading 2yo, seeing off America Queen by 1l in the Group 2 Lowther over C&D (good to firm) at last year's Ebor meeting; also had that reopposing rival and Fitzella behind her when third to True Love in the Cheveley Park at Newmarket in the autumn (final start for Ed Walker); raced keenly and faded into a below-form seventh in 6f Newbury Listed race on reappearance for new connections; fitted with a first-time cheekpieces and tongue-tie combination as she bids to bounce back to form with a bang.
runners.comment: Top 2yo, including C&D Group 2 win; below par on return; headgear combination tried now

runners.name: Kinswoman
runners.spotlight: Progressive sprinter in 2025; promising reappearance second in Yarmouth handicap (5f, good to soft) but hasn't built on it twice since, finishing well held tackling Listed company for the first time at Ayr three weeks ago; her claims aren't obvious.
runners.comment: Useful but well held tackling Listed company for first time latest

runners.name: Fitzella
runners.spotlight: Made all in the Group 3 Princess Margaret Stakes at Ascot (6f, good) last July; finished behind reopposing pair America Queen and Soul Love when below par on first two outings this year but showed she's trained on when very good fifth of 22 in Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), albeit Spicy Marg was just under 3l ahead in second.
runners.comment: Group 3 win at 2; good fifth in Ascot Group 1 latest but Spicy Marg ahead in second

runners.name: America Queen
runners.spotlight: Second to Royal Fixation in last year's Lowther over C&D (good to firm); made an encouraging return when beaten a neck in Group 3 Nell Gwyn at Newmarket (7f, good) in April; faded to finish eighth of 16 in the Jersey at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm) but should find life a bit easier back among her own sex and the return to 6f could also suit; owner/trainer won this last year.
runners.comment: Second in C&D Group 2 as 2yo; faded in 7f Jersey at Ascot and return to 6f may suit

runners.name: Celandine
runners.spotlight: 0-7 since winning the 2024 Lowther over C&D (good to firm) but her third to Sayidah Dariyan in this race last year is her peak RPR; hasn't fired in two outings this year (including fifth to Flora Of Bermuda at Newmarket) but this C&D does seem to bring out the best in her.
runners.comment: Not at best this year but good C&D record provides hope for revival

runners.name: Soul Love
runners.spotlight: Starman filly who took her record to 3-4 when seeing off eight rivals in 6f Goodwood Listed race (good) ten weeks ago; this is harder but it'll be a surprise if this lightly raced filly from a leading yard has reached her limit after only four starts.
runners.comment: Made it 3-4 in 6f Goodwood Listed race and should have more to come for leading stable

runners.name: Catching The Moon
runners.spotlight: Had form figures of 211 last year, culminating with 6f Ayr Listed success on soft (other win on good to firm); well held in the Fred Darling on 7f Newbury reappearance in April, although she wasn't helped by a hefty bump at a crucial stage; off again since.
runners.comment: Listed winner on soft at 2; well held on 7f reappearance in April; off again since

runners.name: Figjam
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up (6f, heavy) last October; also fourth in similar races at Haydock (6f, good to soft) and Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in recent months but her form is more useful than smart and she'll need a big career best to reach the frame in this higher grade.
runners.comment: Has reached frame three times at Listed level but career best needed to do likewise here

runners.name: Fluorescence
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and progressive filly; ran a cracker on what was effectively her seasonal return (unseated her rider soon after start on reappearance) when fourth of 15 in 5f Ayr Listed race (soft) three weeks ago, nearest finish on that occasion so this return to 6f could suit; something to find on form but could have bigger performances in her.
runners.comment: Nearest finish when fourth in 5f Ayr Listed latest so return to 6f may help

runners.name: Hold A Dream
runners.spotlight: Placed four times in Listed grade but below par in two comeback outings this spring (behind Flora Of Bermuda at Newmarket latterly); off ten weeks; even a return to her best is highly unlikely to be enough.
runners.comment: Placed four times at Listed level but below par in two outings this spring

races.race_name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Bear Lee
runners.spotlight: Left 6f debut well behind when overcoming a slow start to win comfortably at Musselburgh (5f, good) ten days ago; has a penalty in what is likely to be a stronger race but she's open to further progress.
runners.comment: Comfortable winner over 5f at Musselburgh last week; this harder but capable of better
runners.owner: N Bradley Racing 29, D Scott & P Spencer

runners.name: Naval Cop
runners.spotlight: Speedy pedigree but her inexperience was evident when a well-held fourth of five on Bath debut (5f, good) 27 days ago; will do better but a good chunk of improvement will be needed to go close.
runners.comment: Green when well-held fourth on Bath debut; in right hands to progress

runners.name: Betty Boop
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye after a slow start when running on to finish third of six on her debut at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) 13 days ago; the runner-up at Lingfield wasn't disgraced in a Sandown Listed event last Friday, particularly as she met trouble; this daughter of Mehmas should go well with improvement on the cards now moving up to 6f.
runners.comment: Promising debut third over 5f and open to improvement with 6f likely to suit better

runners.name: Elevating
runners.spotlight: Showcasing filly who is closely related to 5f winner Fashion Queen (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 106) and half-sister to five other winners; a newcomer to note in the betting.
runners.comment: Closely related to 5f course Listed winner in these silks; check betting

runners.name: Gladys Pugh
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns half-sister to French 1m2f winner Borcano; dam 6f AW winner (RPR 78); stable 2yos are operating at a healthy 20% strike-rate on turf this year; market confidence would look significant.
runners.comment: 200,000gns yearling; market confidence would look significant with yard 2yos going well
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Kirton Angel
runners.spotlight: 70,000gns daughter of Dark Angel who is closely related to 5f 2yo winner Proverb (including French Listed; RPR 102); dam 6f 2yo winner (78); one of two newcomers in this for the stable and they are both bred to go a bit; betting informative.
runners.comment: Bred to be sharp and interesting to see what the betting makes of her

runners.name: Lady Titania
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns Showcasing filly who has winners in her family and is with a top yard; would firmly enter the reckoning if the betting suggests she's fancied.
runners.comment: From a top yard and would firmly enter the reckoning if the betting speaks in her favour

runners.name: Striking Force
runners.spotlight: 52,000gns yearling; closely related to 6.5f/7f winner Chorlton Lane (including 2yo/AW/Australia; RPR 110) and half-sister to 6f winner The Strikin Viking (including 2yo/Group 3; 114); makes paper appeal and interesting to see how she compares in the betting to the yard's other debutante.
runners.comment: Paper appeal; interesting to see how she compares in betting to yard's other newcomer

runners.name: Roman Crystal
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability when fifth of ten at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) nine days ago but she's probably more one for nurseries after this.
runners.comment: Some promise when fifth at Thirsk last week but probably more one for handicaps

runners.name: Get Outta Here
runners.spotlight: Progressive; won a shade cosily on handicap debut at Lingfield (7.5f, good to firm) in May and went down only narrowly to a next-time-out scorer at Goodwood (1m, good) since, despite not enjoying the clearest of runs towards the rail; leading claims.
runners.comment: Progressive; won on handicap debut and close second since; more to come; leading claims

runners.name: Zarvali
runners.spotlight: Ex Irish-trained gelding who improved to make a winning start for Roger Fell in 7f Catterick novice in May; has shaped quite well in a couple of handicaps over that trip since (here first occasion); the way he finished off for third at Thirsk last time suggests this step up to 1m is well worth a go.
runners.comment: Good start for Roger Fell over 7f and latest keeping-on third suggests 1m could suit

runners.name: Spectical
runners.spotlight: New Bay colt who has shown fair form across his three starts (trained first two by Jessica Harrington); went from the front and faded late as if his recent yard debut after nine months off was just needed; blinkers are added for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Might have needed recent yard debut; blinkered now handicapping; unexposed

runners.name: Hambelton
runners.spotlight: Pulled too hard under restraint when a beaten favourite at Haydock (1m, good to soft) in May and a return to front running worked a treat at Cork (1m, good) since, making all by over 3l; the handicapper hasn't missed him but this course often suits similar tactics and David Marnane had a winner here last month.
runners.comment: Ready all-the-way winner at Cork last month; Irish trainer had a winner here recently

runners.name: Milford Grange
runners.spotlight: Knocking at the door, finishing runner-up over 6f/7f (good to soft/soft) on his last three outings (handicaps last twice); the step up to 1m ought to be within range but today's likely ground is an unknown.
runners.comment: Second over 6f/7f on good to soft/soft last three runs; 1m should suit but ground unknown

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Stepped up from 6f to turnover a long odds-on favourite in a match race over 1m at Leicester (good to firm) 15 days ago; hard to be certain of the worth of that form but his rival had been in form with two wins prior to that and this son of Kodiac is unexposed at the new trip.
runners.comment: Stepped up from 6f to win match race over 1m at Leicester latest; unexposed at new trip

runners.name: Bee Farmer
runners.spotlight: Bettered his low-key debut when second (albeit no match for useful winner) at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last month; well below that level at Beverley since but still brings unexposed potential to this handicap debut with the yard going well.
runners.comment: Promise on second of qualifying runs; makes handicap debut with yard going well

runners.name: Illy's Roo
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come over 7f and latest was at Southwell in March; creditable third back there next time but has found it harder on turf since; has returned to the mark he defied at Southwell but has too much too prove, including stamina for 1m (remote last of four previous attempt).
runners.comment: Three 7f wins but has struggled on turf since; remains to be seen if return to 1m helps

runners.name: Luzon Heights
runners.spotlight: Won a Southwell handicap (1m, AW) last September and he's held his form with five creditable efforts since; ridden more prominently than previously when going down only narrowly at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) under Cieren Fallon a fortnight ago; should remain competitive after a 2lb nudge.
runners.comment: AW win last autumn and held form well since, including close second at Yarmouth latest

runners.name: Only Dream Big
runners.spotlight: Much improved under a more positive ride when easily gaining her first win in 7f Redcar handicap last month and backed it up with a narrow success over 1m at Musselburgh three days later, despite her jockey dropping his whip; only fifth of six off this mark at Catterick on Wednesday, though.
runners.comment: Improved to win twice in recent weeks but only fifth at Catterick on Wednesday.

runners.name: Forest Phoenix
runners.spotlight: Got up late to win a 5f Catterick novice (good to firm) in May but beaten upwards of 10l in his four other starts, including a 5f handicap here four weeks ago; hard to know what to expect now taking a marked step back up in trip (first two outings over 7f).
runners.comment: 5f novice win is a standout in five starts; too much to prove back up markedly in trip

runners.name: Dark Moon Rising
runners.spotlight: His 19 course starts have yielded five places and a win over 1m4f back in 2023 but he hasn't been at his best on turf here the last twice; back on a good mark but need to see more.
runners.comment: This course regular is on a good mark but isn't obviously in the form to take advantage

runners.name: Stoneacre Donny
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of a novice at Thirsk (7f, soft) last September and has been placed in all five handicaps since, including C&D; went down only to a progressive sort at Redcar (1m2f, good) last time and should give another good account.
runners.comment: Solid form when placed on all four starts this year, including C&D; considered

runners.name: Kahin
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive; had to work hard to land the odds in 1m1f Hamilton maiden (good to firm) 15 days ago but found plenty for pressure and there should be more to come in handicaps for his top stable, particularly over this slightly longer trip (dam stayed 1m4f).
runners.comment: 1m1f maiden winner recently and should be more to come for top yard in handicaps

runners.name: Ciao Capo
runners.spotlight: Has landed 1m2f fast-ground handicaps at Beverley and Wetherby in recent months; those were Class 6 events so this is a step up in grade but he had a fair bit in hand last time and there is likely more to come.
runners.comment: Has gained his recent wins in Class 6 company but he looks very much on an upward curve

runners.name: Great Bedwyn
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 14 starts but he was a good second of 17 over 1m4f here (good) at the Dante meeting in May; freshened up since a disappointing effort at Thirsk six weeks ago.
runners.comment: Second over 1m4f here in May but well held at Thirsk since and losing run up to 14

runners.name: Beach Point
runners.spotlight: Has done well with cheekpieces, winning twice at 1m2f at Sandown (good/soft) last summer; started 2026 with three creditable in-frame efforts (including good to firm) but needs to shrug off a lesser effort over C&D four weeks ago.
runners.comment: Started 2026 with creditable in-frame efforts but below par here last time
runners.owner: John & Peter Seabrook And Tim Fisher

runners.name: Prince Of The Seas
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Goodwood winner for Ralph Beckett last August off 5lb higher; best run for this yard when chasing home a pair of progressive 3yos at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) last Friday and has handicapping scope if he can build on that.
runners.comment: 1m4f winner off 5lb higher last year; better signs for new yard when third last Friday

runners.name: Bearin Up
runners.spotlight: Has won handicaps around 1m on good at Newmarket and Hamilton in recent months; advanced her form again when second of eight at Chester (extended 1m2f, good) 13 days ago; one of two solid contenders for Tim Easterby.
runners.comment: Dual winner around 1m this year and proved herself over 1m2f at Chester latest

runners.name: Frankies Dream
runners.spotlight: Course winner who is in a consistent vein of form this term, placing in handicaps over 1m1f and 1m here (both good) on his last two outings; this longer trip asks a different question but he's likely to be on the premises again if his stamina holds.
runners.comment: Placed in course handicaps over 1m1f and 1m last twice; should go well if stamina holds

runners.name: Glistening Nights
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner but recent C&D second of 14 is as good as anything he's produced, leading until the final 110yds; a 3lb nudge shouldn't prevent a prominent showing if in similar form.
runners.comment: Recent C&D second of 14 was a career-best RPR; claims if in similar form

races.race_name: William Hill Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap

runners.name: Al Hussar
runners.spotlight: He has turned in a string of good runs this year, winning a 17-runner event at Thirsk in May; while he should give his running it would be a surprise if one or two weren't better handicapped.
runners.comment: String of good runs this year but suspicion one or two will prove better handicapped

runners.name: I'm Dan Dare
runners.spotlight: Firmly on the up for his new stable, making all at Catterick before narrowly denied by Rotokura Belle over C&D; back to winning ways with a Newcastle success 15 days ago (much more convincing than the neck margin might suggest); up 6lb in a better race but he's a speedy and progressive 3yo who commands major respect.
runners.comment: Two wins and a second for new yard; speedy and progressive 3yo; strong contender

runners.name: Equity Law
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a reduced mark to win a 5f handicap at Pontefract (good ground) 19 days ago; still has handicapping scope but this looks competitive enough.
runners.comment: Exploited reduced mark at Pontefract (5f, good) last month; up in class with more required

runners.name: Ancient State
runners.spotlight: His form has scaled new heights since an eyeshield was added, running away with a 6f handicap at Newmarket last month and following up in a small field at Lingfield 13 days ago; a 5lb higher mark against stronger opposition demands another step forward but he's progressive.
runners.comment: Chasing hat-trick after turf wins at Newmarket and Lingfield; up in class but progressive

runners.name: Rotokura Belle
runners.spotlight: Advanced her form with her C&D win last month and when in midfield back here 13 days ago it was in Class 2 company; others appeal as being better treated though.
runners.comment: C&D win last month but only midfield in a stronger race last time; others appeal more

runners.name: Ziggy's Triton
runners.spotlight: The winner of five of his 26 races, including on fast turf; suited by a sharp 5f and this is weaker than the two C&D handicaps he has been well held in this year; others may still have his measure today.
runners.comment: Drops into a Class 4 but he needs to return to his best to defy top weight

runners.name: Eternal Sunshine
runners.spotlight: In fine form last summer, culminating in her Portland win off a 2lb higher mark; slow to come to hand this year but much better dropped back to Class 4 company on her last two starts; this is tougher than the fillies' handicap in which she finished second last week but she is a major player all the same.
runners.comment: Had a fine summer last year; back to form on last two starts; should be in the thick of it

runners.name: Castan
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on AW but he has won on fast turf; good fourth at Ripon in April but he could only manage a midfield finish at Thirsk in May; 2lb lower than when short-headed by Brazen Bolt in this race 12 months ago but he arrived in top form then.
runners.comment: Just pipped in this race last year off 2lb higher; not arriving in quite the same form

runners.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a productive summer last year and he returned to action with a career-best effort at Southwell in January; solid runs in defeat on his last two starts; another big run on the cards.
runners.comment: Arrives on the back of two solid in-frame efforts; should be in the thick of it again

runners.name: Emerald Harmony
runners.spotlight: Ready win in a Class 5 at Thirsk last month; similar form when second in a Class 3 at Doncaster last week; she will need more to come out on top today but she's arriving in top form.
runners.comment: A win and a second from her last two starts; needs more here but wellbeing an obvious plus

runners.name: Counsel
runners.spotlight: 0-15 on turf as opposed to 6-24 on AW; on a winning mark and promising apprentice takes off 5lb but he does need to rebound from a poor run at Doncaster five weeks ago.
runners.comment: Six AW wins but 0-15 on turf and ran poorly at Doncaster five weeks ago

runners.name: Brazen Bolt
runners.spotlight: 4lb higher than for his win in this race 12 months ago, after which he went on to score at Glorious Goodwood; fine return to action (after wind surgery) at Thirsk in May but no progress in two subsequent runs; Warren Fentiman back on board now dropping in class; high on the list.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 4lb lower; drops back in class and holds solid claims

runners.name: Muker
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; won two handicaps last season and he is 10lb lower than for the last of them; not beaten far at Nottingham eight days ago and he's likely to pop up soon.
runners.comment: C&D winner; 10lb lower than for his Doncaster win last July; more promise last time

races.race_name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Apprentice Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Humble Spark
runners.spotlight: Slow starter whose losing run goes back 17 races to March 2025; however, he went down by only a nose over C&D (good) last month and was caught too far back in a Class 2 at Ayr since; bold show likely with his sights lowered.
runners.comment: 17 runs since last win but went close over C&D last month and excuse at Ayr since; player

runners.name: Secret Beach
runners.spotlight: Two 1m4f wins for Ben Brookhouse last year, including this race on good to firm; hasn't seriously threatened back on the Flat for current yard and it remains to be seen whether a return to York sparks a full-scale revival.
runners.comment: Won this last year but doesn't obviously arrive in the same form

runners.name: Nightsinwhitesatin
runners.spotlight: Largely progressive sort in 2025 (when a two-time 1m2f winner) and she's continued on the up stepped up to 1m4f this season, finishing runner-up twice; the Ed Bethell team is in good form, so she should go well back from a seven-week break.
runners.comment: In good form in stable going great guns, so she should go well back from a short break
runners.owner: David Kilburn, Mrs Corbett, Chris Wright

runners.name: Green Sky
runners.spotlight: Has done most of her recent racing over hurdles (0-15) but returned to the Flat to land a second career success easily in 1m4f Chepstow handicap (good to firm) last Friday, her first outing for Rod Millman; 3lb well in under her penalty and likely to be popular with Toby Moore able to claim 7lb against fellow apprentices.
runners.comment: Easy win on Flat return for new yard last week; well in under penalty and Moore claims 7lb

runners.name: Queen Roslyn
runners.spotlight: Won three at up to 2m on the Flat last season, including on good to firm; winner over hurdles in March (2m1f, soft) but well held over 1m2f here back on the Flat four weeks ago; this trip is more suitable but she needs to leave that latest run well behind.
runners.comment: 1m2f was likely on the short side here last time but needed to see more to be positive

runners.name: Nicator
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo; just second handicap when going close at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) 22 days ago; stuck at it well, so this longer trip could be within range.
runners.comment: Unexposed sort who went close in 1m2f Yarmouth handicap latest; up in trip; respected

runners.name: Pleasant Man
runners.spotlight: Ended a lengthy losing run when making all at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month but found out off 3lb higher at Yarmouth since, albeit another creditable effort.
runners.comment: Made all at Doncaster last month but found out off this mark at Yarmouth last month

runners.name: Golden West
runners.spotlight: Promising return from absence when fourth at Chester (10.5f, good to soft) for new yard last month and he was best of the rest behind a handicap blot in the Cumberland Plate at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) since; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Encouraging return from absence and Chester and best of rest behind handicap blot since

runners.name: Optician
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner who made it sixteenth time lucky on turf when seeing off five rivals over 1m4f at Doncaster (good to soft) under  Conor Whiteley 26 days ago; 3lb higher in a deeper race now but the Michael Herrington stable continues in good form.
runners.comment: First turf win was at Doncaster under Conor Whiteley latest and yard continues in form

runners.name: High Fibre
runners.spotlight: Quite useful on the Flat at the start of his career; similar standard over hurdles for Harry Fry in more recent times; sold for £15,000 in July and joined a stable with excels with new recruits.
runners.comment: Two hurdle wins for Harry Fry since last seen on Flat in 2024; joined excellent yard

runners.name: Clouds Hill
runners.spotlight: Made all at Yarmouth (good to firm) on his April return and it was a fine effort when third at Newbury (also 1m2f, good) a fortnight later; couldn't maintain his lead in better events subsequently but this drop back in grade should see him last longer.
runners.comment: Made all (1m2f) on return; brushed aside in better events last two runs but drops in class
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Mythical Guest
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of his four starts here, including when third in this race last year; after a poor start to this term he showed more three weeks ago and has dropped 4lb since; not ruled out despite the losing run racking up.
runners.comment: Placed in three of four starts here, including third in this last year; showed more latest

runners.name: Best Rate
runners.spotlight: 7f AW novice winner in 2024 but 0-17 subsequently; in the frame at 7f on his last four starts, though, and he stays 1m; due for a 2lb drop but still considered.
runners.comment: 7f AW novice winner in 2024 but 0-17 subsequently; in the frame last four starts, though

runners.name: Newfangled
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive since handicapping and it was a personal best when landing 9.5f AW handicap in April; back on turf with solid third of ten off this career-high mark at Windsor (1m, good to firm) one month later and he may still be capable of better.
runners.comment: Personal best to land 9.5f AW h'cap in April; back on turf with good third latest; player

runners.name: Rising Force
runners.spotlight: Better than ever this term; doubled his tally on turf with big-field amateur riders' win at Doncaster (good to soft) in March and he scored again at Thirsk (also 1m, good to firm) in May; back in form when fourth at Goodwood last month and Jack Callan gets on well with him; yard going well; player.
runners.comment: Better than ever this term, winning twice; solid fourth latest and he's a firm contender

runners.name: Helm Rock
runners.spotlight: Five-time turf winner who matched that tally on the AW when landing Kempton handicap (1m) in April; never a threat over that C&D last Thursday and it's been a while since he won off a mark this high.
runners.comment: 10 wins split across turf and AW but he was never a threat last Thursday; mark no gift

runners.name: Paladin
runners.spotlight: Caused a 33-1 surprise when winning on his stable debut in January (8.5f, AW) but after a four-month break he couldn't repeat that level returned to turf when 18th of 22 at York (7f, good) seven weeks ago; tough to predict what can be expected this time.
runners.comment: 33-1 stable debut win in January (8.5f, AW); form not repeated on turf seven weeks ago

runners.name: Chalk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Has seven AW wins to his name, the latest at Kempton (7f) in May, but he's 0-14 on turf; solid fourth in this race last year, however, and latest sixth of 14 (1m, AW; hampered) suggests he can play a part again.
runners.comment: 0-14 on turf but solid fourth in this last year; latest AW run suggests part to play again

runners.name: Mysterious Times
runners.spotlight: 425,000gns yearling who has been favourite for both starts; ran green when third of nine over 5f at Sandown last month and went down narrowly when third of six at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; almost certainly capable of better again and he's the form pick of the unpenalised runners.
runners.comment: Green when third (5f) last month; close third (6f, good to firm) last time; player

runners.name: Persazz
runners.spotlight: Another one to go in at the first time of asking, this time at Ripon (6f, good) three weeks ago; attracted some support that day and holds a couple of valuable sales-race entries; 4lb penalty but likely capable of better.
runners.comment: Debut win (6f, good) 22 days ago; attracted support that day; has big sales-race entries

runners.name: Peaceful Warrior
runners.spotlight: 11-2 when he made a winning debut at Yarmouth (6f, good; made virtually all) seven weeks ago; carries a 6lb penalty for that Class 2 win and holds no big-race entries but that was a promising start.
runners.comment: Made all on debut (6f, good); 6lb penalty and no fancy entries but that was a good start

runners.name: Flann Sunna
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; 7-2 and scored with authority from a subsequent winner on his debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 18 days ago; 4lb penalty but he holds a Group 2 Gimcrack entry and needs considering.
runners.comment: Scored with authority from a subsequent winner on debut; holds a Group 2 Gimcrack entry

runners.name: Keep Grating
runners.spotlight: 16-1 and looked like the experience would do him good when sixth of 11 at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last Tuesday; this is a pretty swift return but he's a candidate to step forward.
runners.comment: It looked like experience would do him good when sixth (6f, good to firm) last Tuesday

runners.name: Washington Royale
runners.spotlight: 11-2, plenty of promise on his debut when fourth of 11 at York (6f, good) a fortnight ago; that first go leaves him not far away on RPRs and there's obvious potential.
runners.comment: Plenty of promise when fourth on debut; that first go leaves him not far away on RPRs

runners.name: No More Pino
runners.spotlight: Had excuses when a fairly encouraging fifth of 11 at Salisbury (soft) last month but he didn't improve when beating two home at Doncaster (also 6f, good to firm) one week ago; likely one for nurseries after this.
runners.comment: Fairly encouraging debut fifth but beat two home next time; one for nurseries after this

runners.name: Crown Office
runners.spotlight: Won Leicester maiden last term but he was gelded after a disappointing comeback at Newbury in April; latest fourth at Sandown (7f, good) offered a good bit more, though, when he still looked a little rough around the edges and also shaped like this step up in trip is the way to go; respected.
runners.comment: Gelded before offering more when fourth last time; goes up in trip and he's respected

runners.name: Arbaawy
runners.spotlight: 0-10 but he has regularly been placed and is running well this season, including when beaten 2l for fourth of five at Sandown (1m1f, good) four weeks ago; yard in fine form and he's got each-way claims again.
runners.comment: 0-10 but he keeps running well and his yard's in fine form; each-way claims

runners.name: Crest Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to this campaign which he kicked off with clearcut maiden win on AW and he then finished good third of 14 in the Silver Bowl at Carlisle (also 1m, good to firm); drawn on the wrong side when finishing midfield in his group in the Britannia on the straight mile here last month; earlier Carlisle form puts him in the picture.
runners.comment: No show from poor draw at the Royal meeting but previous third puts him in the picture

runners.name: Abundant
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner last year who made an encouraging handicap debut/return when fourth at Windsor (good to firm) in May; stepped up on that when close third at Goodwood (also 1m, good; Ciarrai Abu fourth) three weeks ago; winner of that race has gone in again since, as has the fifth; likely to sit handy from his low draw and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Close third three weeks ago; that form's worked out and he enters calculations

runners.name: Starlight Time
runners.spotlight: Two juvenile wins came on his debut at Epsom (7f, good) around a year ago and at Chelmsford (1m, AW) in November; back at the former track when stepped up to 1m2f on soft ground for his handicap debut/reappearance but raced freely and was beaten 56l; that needs a lot of forgiving but the drop back to 1m, better ground and new hood are all reasons to expect better.
runners.comment: Heavy defeat on handicap debut/return; drop back to 1m/better ground/new hood could help

runners.name: Assaranca
runners.spotlight: Looked a little flattered when sneaking up the near-side rail to score at Lingfield (good to firm) in May but she more than matched that with very creditable fifth of six in Epsom Listed event (again 7f, good to soft) next time; never threatened in similar event at Carlisle a fortnight ago, however, which tempers confidence on this return to handicaps.
runners.comment: Creditable Listed fifth of six (7f, good to soft) last month was not backed up last time

runners.name: Ciarrai Abu
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough with a winning return in May and it was a very promising handicap debut when close fourth (again Goodwood, 1m, good; Abundant third) three weeks ago; was unlucky not to get even closer that day and the form is already working out; big player.
runners.comment: Very promising handicap debut when close fourth (1m, good) three weeks ago; big player

runners.name: Loz Vegas
runners.spotlight: Built on his May return when close-up fifth of 13 at Newmarket (1m, good; fourth and eighth have won subsequently) three weeks ago; didn't have a clear path that day and a 1lb drop won't hurt his cause; considered.
runners.comment: Not clear run when close fifth (1m, good) latest; that form's worked out; considered

runners.name: Ya Karim
runners.spotlight: Made all to win small-field Yarmouth novice (good) in October and he'd been gelded before giving it a good go when third of 13 at Kempton (again 7f, AW) on handicap debut in May; still early days and pedigree suggests this step up in trip is a positive; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Gave it a good go when third (7f, AW) on h'cap debut; up in trip and it's still early days

runners.name: Mr Seagull
runners.spotlight: His narrow debut success in August hasn't been added to in six subsequent starts, including in three handicaps this term, latterly at 10.5f; drops in trip from a reduced mark but others have more compelling claims.
runners.comment: 0-3 in handicaps this term; drops in trip from a reduced mark but others preferred
runners.owner: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four

runners.name: Shaman Champion
runners.spotlight: No wins since a promising debut success at Leicester last May and he failed to build on a fairly encouraging stable debut/reappearance in April when never a threat at Goodwood (7f) seven weeks ago; needs to stage a revival on this first go at 1m.
runners.comment: Fairly encouraging stable debut/reappearance but never a threat latest; first go at 1m

runners.name: Gatehouse
runners.spotlight: Won on the AW at Chelmsford (1m2f) in December and Southwell (1m handicap) in April; hung left when well held on his turf debut at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) in May but resumed improvement when favourite for six-runner race at Nottingham (1m2f, good) one month later, beaten a neck as the first two drew clear; up 4lb but should be a player again.
runners.comment: Resumed improvement when beaten a neck in six-runner race at Nottingham (1m2f, good)

runners.name: Morbeh
runners.spotlight: Unraced on firmer than good except when well beaten on debut; highly progressive in handicaps and won at Windsor (11.4f, good) and Chester (10.3f, good to soft; first two 5l clear) on last two outings; keeps on finding more, and it's rash to say he can't do it again, but 9lb rise demands it for sure.
runners.comment: Highly progressive and is on a hat-trick; keeps on finding more but 9lb rise demands it

runners.name: Golden Knight
runners.spotlight: Made all in a novice at Newmarket (1m, good) last October on second start; well held this term in Listed race at Sandown (1m, good) and handicap at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) but there was market interest in him for the latter (14-1) and the widest draw did not play out to his advantage on his way to 12th of 19; dropped just 1lb but one to note.
runners.comment: There was market interest in him at Royal Ascot (1m4f) where he had the widest draw

runners.name: Samuel Colt
runners.spotlight: 0-8 since his winning debut as 2yo for Aidan O'Brien; six starts for this yard and four were Class 2 handicaps but he didn't fare any better in a 1m2f Class 3 at Sandown (40-1) and whether he can take advantage of a small-field Class 4 today has to be in doubt; hooded this season except today.
runners.comment: Whether he can take advantage of a small-field Class 4 today has to be in doubt

runners.name: Hoseki
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on her return when landing a Redcar maiden (good to firm) in May and she made a winning handicap debut at Chester (also about 1m2f, good) one month later; pedigree suggests 1m4f will see this unexposed filly progress again.
runners.comment: Off the mark on return; winning handicap debut latest; new trip can suit in hat-trick bid

runners.name: Dojin
runners.spotlight: Kept to AW for her first five starts and she won three of them, including handicaps at Kempton over this sort of trip in the spring; weak in the market when beaten 7l into second on her turf debut at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but maybe this drop back down in trip can assist.
runners.comment: Weak in market when beaten 7l into second on 1m6f turf debut latest; drops back in trip

runners.name: Sibling Rivelry
runners.spotlight: Three wins last year and she made it four overall when doing well to score on her comeback at Windsor (11.5f, good to firm) in May; back in that sort of form when third at Yarmouth three weeks ago but she'll need a career best in this company.
runners.comment: Back in form when third three weeks ago but will need a career best in this company

runners.name: Folk Pageant
runners.spotlight: Won four of her first five starts this year, including the Lester Piggott handicap (1m2f, soft; acts on quicker) at Epsom on Derby day; dropped out of contention in the Golden Gates at the Royal meeting but she's the sort to bounce back and her pedigree offers plenty of hope for this new trip; considered.
runners.comment: Won four of her first five starts this year; weakened latest but the sort to bounce back
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Nochebuena
runners.spotlight: Improved on her reappearance when neck second of six at Haydock (1m2f, soft) in May and she worried the runner-up out of it when making the breakthrough upped to this trip at Doncaster (good to soft) four weeks ago; likely there's better to come from this handicap debutante.
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough upped to this trip four weeks ago; unexposed handicap debutante

runners.name: Lady Ridgewood
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner for Peter Chapple-Hyam last term but it was an inauspicious start for this yard when suffering two heavy defeats in the spring; possibly flattered when fourth of six at Chester (10.5f, soft) four weeks ago but she's not handicapped out of this if that signals a revival in fortunes; first try at this trip (sister to a Grade 3 1m4f winner).
runners.comment: Possibly flattered when fourth last time but not h'capped out of this & new trip may suit

runners.name: Incensed
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner whose third of nine in Goodwood Listed race (1m4f, good) in May looks all the better now; midfield finish in the 16-runner 1m6f Copper Horse handicap at the Royal meeting was no disgrace and she's not dismissed.
runners.comment: Listed third (1m4f) in May looks all the better now and not disgraced at the Royal meeting

runners.name: Brielle
runners.spotlight: Returned with a win in Thirsk handicap (first-time tongue-tie) in May and appeared to run well again when 33-1 sixth of nine in a Listed race at Pontefract (also 1m4f, good) last month; returns to handicaps having been handed another 4lb rise.
runners.comment: Reappeared with handicap win; handed another 4lb rise after Listed sixth last time

runners.name: Amazing Journey
runners.spotlight: Novice and nursery-winning juvenile (6f, good to firm) who often didn't have things go his way subsequently until he won going away at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; wasn't totally handling the track when narrow second at Epsom last Wednesday and he's an obvious contender off this mark (due a 2lb rise).
runners.comment: Won penultimate start; not in love with Epsom when just held recently; due a 2lb rise

runners.name: Diligently
