runners.spotlight: First handicap win when he scored at Windsor in August and he'd dropped to the same mark when registering another win over that C&D (also good to firm) 25 days ago; 2lb nudge but everything that's come out of that race has run well subsequently, including wins for the runner-up and ninth, and he's firmly considered in his follow-up bid.
runners.comment: 6f Windsor win 25 days ago has been receiving boosts; firmly considered in follow-up bid

runners.name: Fast Track Harry
runners.spotlight: Only seventh when favourite for this race last year; posted two successive career bests on AW in February and March but those efforts haven't been matched since, on the last three occasions in turf handicaps; drops in grade with cheekpieces added to his tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Career bests on AW in Feb/March haven't been matched; down in grade with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Ray Mon Dough
runners.spotlight: Made all for wide-margin win on his debut at Lingfield (AW) in November and he was back around that sort of form when second in good-ground novice there (also 6f) in May; stall 1 might not be ideal but look for market confidence on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Made all for wide-margin debut win; back in that form with latest second; handicap debut

runners.name: Sapphire Steps
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to her debut success at Newbury around this time last year and her fourth of nine at Newmarket (also 6f, good to firm), while respectable, will need building on.
runners.comment: Yet to add to debut success; latest fourth (also 6f, good to firm) will need building on
runners.owner: J Palmer-Brown, C Engel And Partner

runners.name: Another Abbot
runners.spotlight: Two 6f wins last year and registered a third when coming out on top in a good tussle at Yarmouth (good to firm) in late May; up to this grade and caught a little wide when last of seven at Salisbury ten days ago, however.
runners.comment: Came out on top in good tussle (6f, good to firm) in May; underwhelmed last time

runners.name: Russet Gold
runners.spotlight: Encouraging start for this yard with two fifth-place finishes at Leicester and York (also 6f) in the spring but his last two starts haven't been as promising; nicely treated and he does have form here so a revival isn't out of the question.
runners.comment: Encouraging start for yard not built on; nicely treated and does have form here, however

runners.name: Bolo Neighs
runners.spotlight: Sole visit here yielded a win over this trip (good) in May but he hasn't figured in two subsequent starts, including when always behind at Windsor 11 days ago; hopes rest on a return to this course firing him back up.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May but hasn't figured in two starts since; return to this track may help

runners.name: Coul Angel
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner (four on AW) who ran well when fourth of 16 last May on his only outing here; chased home a handicap blot on his return to turf in April and he was back in that form when second at Windsor (again 6f, good to firm; Bolo Neighs behind) 11 days ago; in the mix once more.
runners.comment: Chased home handicap blot in April; back in that form when second latest; in the mix

runners.name: Superposition
runners.spotlight: Dual winner at 1m who was dropped back down to 7f when he scored at Newmarket (good) in May; stayed on for third over that trip on the July course a fortnight ago so this first start at 6f is something of a surprise.
runners.comment: Dual 1m winner who scored over 7f (good) in May; first start at 6f is a little surprising

runners.name: Purest Time
runners.spotlight: First win for nearly two years when he picked up a Windsor handicap (6f, good to firm) off 3lb lower in May and his subsequent effort at Chester, when never competitive, was a puzzling one a fortnight ago; same mark but it would not be a big surprise if he bounced back.
runners.comment: Picked up a 6f handicap off 3lb lower in May; latest was puzzling but could bounce back

runners.name: So Darn Hot
runners.spotlight: Four wins at 6f for previous yard but he was far from disgraced when seventh of 28 in 7f Victoria Cup here (good; first-time cheekpieces) in May; drawn on the wrong side when he finished last at the Royal meeting but he's dropped to a handy mark and shouldn't be discounted on this return to 6f.
runners.comment: Four wins at 6f; not disgraced over 7f here in May and excuse latest; each-way alternative

runners.name: Twilight Jet
runners.spotlight: Snapped a long losing sequence when justifying support from a dangerous mark at Lingfield (6f, good) in May and he scampered clear over that C&D (good to firm) 12 days later; back up to this mark when respectable sixth of 15 at Epsom (soft) on Derby day.
runners.comment: Two wins off lower and was back up to this mark when respectable sixth of 15 last time

runners.name: Luciole Des Bordes
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two bumpers; application of the hood did not help her settle on her hurdles debut at Tramore in May; Townend sticks with her but has a question to answer now; headgear left on.
runners.comment: Too free in the hood at Tramore; Townend sticks with her but has a question to answer now

runners.name: Lumiere Du Large
runners.spotlight: Regressive profile in general over hurdles; decent second in a Sligo maiden hurdle in May on her stable debut, but has not progressed in two runs since; back to 2m here but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Not a progressive mare; back to 2m here but others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Brave Lady
runners.spotlight: Gradually finding her feet again after an eight-month break; hurdles debut after good efforts in bumpers at Limerick and Punchestown; ground will suit and a good alternative to the likely favourite.
runners.comment: Hurdles debut after good efforts in bumpers at Limerick and Punchestown; ground will suit

runners.name: Belladaball
runners.spotlight: Decent bumper mare, landing a Listed contest at Fairyhouse over Easter; unable to get competitive in a Grade 3 at Punchestown when last seen; unproven on quicker ground but has been found a reasonable opportunity for her hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Unproven on quicker ground but has been found a decent opportunity for her hurdles debut

runners.name: Phyllis Rodda
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to good stayer Salvador Ziggy; pulled up on both point starts for Roger Loughran; others much more likely but worth keeping an eye on.
runners.comment: Others much more likely but worth keeping an eye on

runners.name: Longhouse Legacy
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer for Sam Curling three years ago; runner-up in a Huntingdon bumper for her previous trainer; stable debut here after 20 months off, but very much respected with the stable in terrific form.
runners.comment: Stable debut after 20 months off but very much respected with the stable in terrific form

runners.name: Noble Rocco
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; not a factor in a Ballinrobe bumper on debut in May.
runners.comment: Second reserve; not a factor in a Ballinrobe bumper on debut in May

runners.name: Fastnet Crystal
runners.spotlight: First reserve; narrowly beaten in a Thurles bumper in December; made a noise when virtully pulled up at Punchestown the following month; clearly of interest if getting a run.
runners.comment: First reserve; narrowly beaten in a Thurles bumper; clearly of interest if getting a run
runners.owner: Nicholas Fahy/Mrs Orla Fahy/Two Sheets to the Wind Syndicate

runners.name: Jolly d'Olivate
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; point winner last November, pulled up on both runs in that discipline in the spring.
runners.comment: Third reserve; point winner last November, pulled up on both point runs in the spring

runners.name: Ivana d'Alco
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer for Jonathan Fogarty in January; automatically of interest from these quarters but Townend prefers Luciole Des Bordes.
runners.comment: Automatically of interest from these quarters but Townend prefers Luciole Des Bordes

runners.name: Cailin Hill
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to point winner Wolf Walker; dam unplaced bumpers/hurdles/points, half-sister to winners Perfect Man (2m4f-3m2f hurdle) and Perfect Woman (2m1f-2m4f hurdle/chase), out of sister to smart staying hurdler Merry Masquerade; stamina-laden pedigree and best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Stamina-laden pedigree and best watched on debut

runners.name: Inver Bay
runners.spotlight: Very modest form for Gerry Keane; quite an eye-catching run, though, on her stable debut in a Punchestown maiden hurdle last month; could well have more to offer.
runners.comment: Eye-catching run on her stable debut at Punchestown latest; could well have more to offer

runners.name: Messonghi
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam 1m6f Flat (RPR 69)/2m hurdle winner, sister to 1m3f-2m winner Mymatechris, half-sister to winners Pao De Acuca (1m4f/2m), Harangue (2m4f-2m7f hurdle) and Doitforjane Sid (2m7f-3m2f hurdle); likely to stay well; best watched though on her debut.
runners.comment: Likely to stay well; best watched though on her debut

runners.name: My Elusive Mate
runners.spotlight: Not a factor in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle on debut; much more needed here.
runners.comment: Not a factor in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle on debut; much more needed here

runners.name: Thedreamistilalive
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; unraced dam closely related to bumper and 3m hurdle/chase winner Rhaegar, half-sister to winners Stellar Notion (bumper and useful 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase) and Forged In Fire (bumper/2m3f chase); unlikely to be a factor here on debut and best watched.
runners.comment: Unlikely to be a factor here on debut and best watched

runners.name: Santa Paula
runners.spotlight: Beat just one rival in two bumpers; fell in a point-to-point in May after a long absence; never threatened on hurdling debut at Punchestown last month.
runners.comment: Never threatened on hurdling debut at Punchestown last month; others preferred

runners.name: Pepper Noir
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on polytrack for Gavin Cromwell; failed to complete twice over hurdles and nothing positive about her display at Bellewstown last week.
runners.comment: Failed to complete twice over hurdles; nothing positive about her Bellewstown display

runners.name: Hillhead Runner
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner for Peter Fahey and some solid efforts over flights last summer for Gavin Cromwell; cheekpieces tried here after an okay run at Downpatrick last time; should be a player in a tricky contest.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces tried after an okay run at Downpatrick; should be a player in a tricky contest

runners.name: Penny Express
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a pair of maiden hurdles last summer; fourth in a Listowel maiden hurdle last month shows he is coming to hand; should be a major player here.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Listowel maiden hurdle last month shows he is coming to hand; major player

runners.name: All Night Revival
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten at Fairyhouse last November in the second of two bumper outings for Nigel Slevin; took a step backwards over hurdles at the Punchestown festival, but on ratings he should not be far away.
runners.comment: Took a step backwards over hurdles at Punchestown but on ratings he should not be far away

runners.name: Imarajan
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden ran his best race over hurdles when runner-up in a C&D maiden hurdle last time;  headgear combination worn then is retained; can be involved again.
runners.comment: Best run over hurdles when runner-up in a C&D maiden hurdle latest; can be involved again

runners.name: Chantilly Wings
runners.spotlight: Some solid enough maiden hurdle form on good ground last summer; tongue-tie tried here after 10 months off and can give a good account if fit enough.
runners.comment: Tongue-tie tried here after 10 months off and can give a good account if fit enough

runners.name: Urinmydreams
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any ability in bumpers and over hurdles; makes no appeal.
runners.comment: Yet to show any ability in bumpers and over hurdles; makes no appeal

runners.name: Codger's Rock
runners.spotlight: Only showed a slight glimmer of promise in first three maidens but best effort yet when narrowly beaten over 2m here in May; the third has franked the form; respected back up in trip over a track he likes.
runners.comment: Narrowly beaten over 2m here in May; respected back up in trip over a track he likes

runners.name: Georg Zhukov
runners.spotlight: Won a Dundalk handicap off 51 in January; not disgraced on his return to hurdles at Cork over Easter; a bit more on his plate here.
runners.comment: Not disgraced on his return to hurdles at Cork over Easter; a bit more on his plate here

runners.name: Paul's Dream
runners.spotlight: Mostly reliable in the first half of last season; enjoyed a fine spell during which she notched two wins and two seconds; bolted up at Ballinrobe in May on her second start after a break; appears fortunate to have got away with a 6lb rise; strong chance with Harry Cobden booked.
runners.comment: Bolted up at Ballinrobe in May, appears fortunate to have got away with a 6lb rise

runners.name: Stede Bonnet
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner is 2-7 over hurdles; won a Tramore maiden on New Year's Day (2m1f, soft) and Ayr novice (2m, soft) the following month; failed to fire in the Martin Pipe at Cheltenham; chased home an easy winner at Roscommon last month; better ground should suit, judged on bumper form.
runners.comment: Dual bumper winner, capable hurdler with potential to improve his current rating

runners.name: Gameball
runners.spotlight: Impressive winner of a Ballinrobe bumper for Andrew Slattery and moved to this yard after; won a Punchestown maiden hurdle last October before finishing fourth in a Fairyhouse Grade 2 novice; third in a conditions event at the Punchestown festival; relatively unexposed, plenty of weight for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Third in a conditions event at the Punchestown festival, relatively unexposed, big burden

runners.name: Nelson Muntz
runners.spotlight: Sole success achieved at odds-on in a maiden hurdle at this venue last autumn; placed twice from 11 starts on the Flat, the most recent when second over 2m at Tramore on Tuesday; trainer also runs Faceman.
runners.comment: Course maiden hurdle winner at 2m, solid Flat display when second at Tramore on Tuesday

runners.name: Faceman
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins last year, a maiden at this venue (good) and a three-runner novice event at Tramore (good); fell five out on chasing debut at Tramore in April; returned to hurdling to record a neck victory in a 3m contest here eight weeks ago; 4lb higher with useful 5lb claimed.
runners.comment: Narrow winner of a 3m contest here eight weeks ago, 4lb higher with useful 5lb claimed

runners.name: Grann's Boy
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose; 3-12 over hurdles; solid Flat run at Navan (1m6f, heavy) in March; has failed to show his best form in three subsequent handicap hurdles outings; remains 7lb above last winning mark; seems best with at least some ease in the ground.
runners.comment: Fair dual-purpose sort, seems best with some ease in the ground, unconvincing recent form

runners.name: Kamikaz Du Plessis
runners.spotlight: Last five races for Gordon Elliott were over fences; has suitable ground for stable debut (won twice on good last summer); cheekpieces now added to the tongue-tie used in chases.
runners.comment: Last five races for Gordon Elliott were over fences, has suitable ground for stable debut

runners.name: Ad Caelum
runners.spotlight: Has established a good record at this venue; gained a second course win last month, also twice runner-up here; this is a bit shorter than her optimum trip.
runners.comment: Has established a good record at this venue, this is a bit shorter than her optimum trip

runners.name: Moon Mission
runners.spotlight: Winner of a Cork novice event on good ground; also has one decent soft-ground handicap run to his name, a third placing at Punchestown in January; contested a conditions race at Wexford last time; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, winner of a Cork novice event, also has one good handicap run to his name
runners.owner: J T O'Connor & M P Gleeson & P M Fortune & A McGonigle

runners.name: Littlefoot
runners.spotlight: Second off 2lb higher than this in a handicap hurdle at Tipperary last October (2m, good); form tailed off after; relished the switch to fences when scoring at Downpatrick in March; put a below-par Cork run behind him with a course handicap chase win in May; could feature off a mark 10lb lower than his revised chase rating.
runners.comment: Promoted to 128 after a course handicap chase win, could feature off 10lb lower mark

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles, 1-15 over fences; second twice over fences on decent ground at Musselburgh in January, and third in a chase at Wexford last week; previously out of the money behind Ad Caelum in a handicap hurdle at this venue.
runners.comment: Placed over fences at Wexford last week, previously out of the money behind Ad Caelum here

runners.name: Has Me Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Got up late to win a 2m maiden at this venue in 2024; entitled to need this after such a long absence; worth a look for future reference; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, got up late to win a 2m maiden at this venue in 2024, entitled to need this

runners.name: Ryan's Son
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner on good ground at Roscommon last summer; lame on only subsequent 2025 start; ran in a competitive race at Punchestown on handicap debut; relatively unexposed type; of some interest; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, maiden winner on good ground, relatively unexposed type, of some interest

runners.name: Thecompanysergeant
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner and a winning chaser; 3-13 over hurdles and rated 135; mark left unchanged after an odds-on win at Clonmel; smart sort but has never won a handicap.
runners.comment: Mark left unchanged after an odds-on win at Clonmel, smart but has never won a handicap

runners.name: Gin Tonic
runners.spotlight: In good form last October/November, notching a maiden win at Wexford and second in a novice contest at Fairyhouse; risky proposition now after consecutive failures to complete.
runners.comment: Good form last year, risky proposition now after consecutive failures to complete

runners.name: Harry Des Ongrais
runners.spotlight: Ex-Henry de Bromhead; third in Listed handicap chase at Navan in December; lost form after; best runs have been on soft; sold for 28,000gns in March and makes stable debut here.
runners.comment: Ex-Henry de Bromhead, third in a handicap chase at Navan last December, lost form after

runners.name: Lisnamult Lad
runners.spotlight: Has lost his way since a fine second in the 2025 Topham; four non-completions from six starts; recent return to hurdling has failed to spark a revival in form.
runners.comment: Lost his way over fences, recent return to hurdling has failed to spark a revival in form

runners.name: Bottler'secret
runners.spotlight: Second to the top-class Kargese in a Grade 1 juvenile event in 2024; fair form on the Flat year; has become regressive over jumps; failed to take to chasing last winter.
runners.comment: Second to the top-class Kargese in a Grade 1 juvenile event in 2024, has become regressive

races.race_name: Kilmurray Group Midlands National Handicap Chase (Listed Race)

runners.name: Raglan Road
runners.spotlight: Found two winnable opportunities in small-field novice chases at Down Royal and Punchestown; well beaten in a competitive novice handicap chase at the Punchestown festival in between; hard to assess in the context of this race, but looks the first string of the McManus quartet and is respected.
runners.comment: Hard to assess in the context of this race but looks first string of the McManus quartet

runners.name: Yoradreamer
runners.spotlight: Dual winner; no real match for Raglan Road in a three-runner contest at Punchestown last month; still relatively unexposed and not one to take lightly.
runners.comment: Dual winner; still relatively unexposed and not one to take lightly

runners.name: Invictus Machin
runners.spotlight: Second in a C&D handicap chase last year; very solid efforts in Listed contests at Leopardstown and Punchestown before a disappointing effort in the Mayo National; a definite player if he comes back to his previous form.
runners.comment: Disappointing in the Mayo National; a definite player if coming back to his previous form

runners.name: Will Do
runners.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner is 0-16 over fences; has run some smart races in defeat in valuable handicaps, but has been pulled up in three of his last four starts so comes with plenty of risks attached now; on a dangerous mark if rediscovering best.
runners.comment: Pulled up in three of his last four starts so comes with plenty of risks attached

runners.name: Boston Rover
runners.spotlight: Winning sequence came to an abrupt halt when pulled up at Limerick in the Munster National when last seen in October; better ground an obvious plus and not at all dismissed, despite the almost nine-month absence.
runners.comment: Ground an obvious plus and not at all dismissed despite the almost nine month absence

runners.name: Solitary Man
runners.spotlight: Fair novice chaser before going pointing and hunter chasing; again showed his affinity for Killarney when winning a hunter chase there in May before disappointing at Listowel; more needed.
runners.comment: Hunter chase win at Killarney in May before disappointing at Listowel; more needed
runners.owner: Shanahan/Mrs M V Magnier/Mrs Carthy/Mrs Bartlett

runners.name: Drumgill
runners.spotlight: Seven career wins but unable to make any impression behind Native Speaker at Ballinrobe or over 2m4f here last time; needs to up his game.
runners.comment: No impression behind Native Speaker at Ballinrobe or over 2m4f here last time; more needed

runners.name: Shanbally Kid
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin winner of a staying handicap chase at Punchestown 14 months ago, but no real trace of that form since; switches from Willie Mullins to Gordon Elliott to try to improve his fortunes, but others preferred.
runners.comment: Switches to Gordon Elliott to try to improve his fortunes but others preferred

runners.name: Uncle Pat
runners.spotlight: Several near misses before getting off the mark in spectacular fashion over 3m7f at Punchestown in April; up 12lb for that and extreme distances may well be what he wants, but this trip should be fine and he is a leading contender.
runners.comment: Off the mark in spectacular fashion over 3m7f at Punchestown in April; leading contender
runners.owner: Patrick Corbett & Michael Corbett & J J Corbett & W Clancy

runners.name: A Penny A Hundred
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; ran okay when probably needing the run in the Connacht National last time; more needed.
runners.comment: Third reserve; ran okay when maybe needing the run in the Connacht National; more needed

runners.name: Pride Of Place
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin winner of a Listowel handicap chase last year and confirmed his progression when winning the Killarney National in May; even with his 9lb penalty, he was well below par at Roscommon since; others preferred.
runners.comment: Even with his 9lb penalty he was well below par at Roscommon latest; others preferred

runners.name: Lonesome Boatman
runners.spotlight: First reserve; Cork National winner mostly disappointing since, but could be interesting back on good ground.
runners.comment: First reserve; Cork National winner could be interesting back on good ground

runners.name: Moonovercloon
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; yet to win over fences; beaten a long way over hurdles on his stable debut here last month; should strip fitter but likely to fall short.
runners.comment: Second reserve; beaten a long way over hurdles on his stable debut here last month

runners.name: Native Speaker
runners.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler and showed that when leaving some of these rivals behind in the Mayo National at Ballinrobe in May; 9lb looks a tolerable rise and he looks likely to play a leading role here; has won here over hurdles.
runners.comment: Impressed in the Mayo National at Ballinrobe; looks likely to play a leading role here

runners.name: Amirite
runners.spotlight: Was in the form of his life in the spring and summer of last year, victory in this race being followed by an excellent fourth in the Galway Plate; by contrast, his spring form this year leaves plenty to be desired, but he is only 3lb higher than last year and cannot be dismissed with the stable in such form.
runners.comment: Only 3lb higher than last year's win and cannot be dismissed with the stable in such form

runners.name: Olympic Man
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler-chaser for Willie Mullins; fine run on his stable debut when fifth in the Kim Muir at Cheltenham; fell over banks at Punchestown; trip and ground are fine and has an each-way chance.
runners.comment: Fifth in the Kim Muir at Cheltenham; fell over banks at Punchestown; trip and ground fine

runners.name: Perceval Legallois
runners.spotlight: A while now since he was at his very best with two big Leopardstown wins two seasons ago; well beaten in the Mayo National last time and looks best left alone at the present time.
runners.comment: Well beaten in the Mayo National last time and looks best left alone at the present time

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase

runners.name: Scalpnagoon
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles; yet to be quite as effective over fences and disappointed over 2m at Wexford last time; interesting stepped up in trip and could leave that form behind.
runners.comment: Interesting stepped up in trip and could leave his Wexford form behind

runners.name: Franciscan Rock
runners.spotlight: Much the best of these over hurdles, probably a career-best effort when second in the race formerly known as the Coral Cup at Cheltenham in March; yet to reach that level over fences, but this looks his best opportunity to date.
runners.comment: Yet to reach his best level over fences but this looks his best opportunity to date

runners.name: Kevin's Pride
runners.spotlight: Consistent performer over hurdles, but jumped poorly on his chase debut at Wexford in March and well beaten back over flights since at Down Royal; questions to answer.
runners.comment: Well beaten back over flights last time at Down Royal; questions to answer

runners.name: Juke Hill
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; took well to fences when just run out of it late in a beginners at Wexford last week; steps up in trip here and looks likely to be a better chaser than hurdler.
runners.comment: Steps up in trip here and, on Wexford run, looks likely to be better chaser than hurdler

runners.name: Tonaghneave Well
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner over hurdles; rated 12lb lower over fences and deservedly so on the book; remains capable of much better.
runners.comment: Rated 12lb lower over fences and deservedly so on the book; remains capable of much better

runners.name: Centreofattention
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner for Nicky Henderson, but very lightly raced since and overall form does not leave much room for optimism.
runners.comment: Very lightly raced since bumper win and overall form does not leave much room for optimism

runners.name: Orkneys Jack
runners.spotlight: Returned from the point-to-point circuit to run a decent race in a beginners' chase over 2m4f here last month; likely to stay well and could run into a place.
runners.comment: Decent run in a beginners' chase over 2m4f here last month; likely to stay well

runners.name: Charlie Luciano
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner over hurdles and has performed respectably over fences without winning; not a bad run in a 2m4f handicap here last time after seven months off and can go well.
runners.comment: Not a bad run in a 2m4f handicap here last time after seven months off and can go well

runners.name: Bowgate Street
runners.spotlight: 1-28 over hurdles; soundly beaten in races at Ballinrobe and Downpatrick since a breakthrough win at Sligo; others preferred.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in two outings since a breakthrough win at Sligo, others preferred

runners.name: Chesterbaylad
runners.spotlight: Attracted support at Down Royal in early May, let down by his jumping; much more like it when second in a 19-runner contest at Punchestown nine days later; failed to build on that at this venue next time, this longer trip may suit him better.
runners.comment: Career-best when second at Punchestown, failed to build on that at this venue next time

runners.name: High Notions
runners.spotlight: Third here on penultimate start; failed to handle the track at Downpatrick in a race won by Georginas Jet; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, third here on penultimate start, failed to handle the track at Downpatrick
runners.owner: I'm Going To No Home Syndicate

runners.name: Kentucky Bluebird
runners.spotlight: One of her better efforts on latest when fourth at Wexford; needs to raise her game; strong trainer/rider combination; worth a market check.
runners.comment: One of her better efforts on latest when fourth at Wexford, needs to raise her game

runners.name: Backwithyourown
runners.spotlight: Fair form, without winning, in bumpers and maiden hurdles; unseated at the first at Wexford in May, so effectively no run since last October; form includes a 14l second in a 2m course maiden.
runners.comment: Unseated at the first at Wexford in May, form includes a 14l second in a 2m course maiden

runners.name: Annarubyrose
runners.spotlight: Good run over 2m6f at Downpatrick after a break; below that level when fourth over the same course and trip last time; contender if making the line-up; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, good run over 2m6f at Downpatrick after a break, below that level last time

runners.name: Granlahan
runners.spotlight: Promoted to third at Limerick in May after the winner's disqualification; followed that with a fair third at Sligo; hampered and unseated at the sixth at Bellewstown last week.
runners.comment: Hampered and unseated at the sixth at Bellewstown last week, Sligo third was encouraging

runners.name: Boston Bobby
runners.spotlight: Long-priced winner on yielding ground at Down Royal in December; may have needed Bellewstown run in April; fair effort at 33-1 at Sligo a month ago, not far behind third-placed Granlahan despite not getting the best of runs.
runners.comment: Has run only twice since a Down Royal win last December, fair effort at 33-1 at Sligo

runners.name: Monty's Way
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat for Joseph O'Brien; modest hurdles form apart from a shock win at Ballinrobe in May 2024; tailed off at Wexford in May after a winter break.
runners.comment: Useful on the Flat for Joseph O'Brien, modest hurdles form apart from a shock win in 2024

runners.name: Vairue
runners.spotlight: Off for almost two years after winning at Thurles in 2022; returns now after another long absence; trainer has a stronger candidate here in Chesterbaylad.
runners.comment: Off for almost two years after a 2022 Thurles win, returns now after another long absence

runners.name: Scathach
runners.spotlight: Finished in mid-field in a strong Leopardstown maiden on debut; remote sixth behind Bambino Fever at Fairyhouse in January, made mistakes and fell two out at Naas in February; beaten favourite in two maidens in recent months; Sligo third was respectable, and the bar is set low for her handicap debut
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in two maidens in recent months, Sligo third was respectable at least

runners.name: Maybe Someday
runners.spotlight: Remote fourth in a conditions race here last month; her single bumper run (at Tramore last August) was satisfactory; unconvincing hurdles form.
runners.comment: Remote fourth in a conditions race here last month, her single bumper run was satisfactory

runners.name: Not So Serious
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; pulled up in handicap outings over longer trips than this at Tramore in May and this venue last month.
runners.comment: Weak form in maidens, pulled up in two handicap hurdle outings over longer trips than this

runners.name: Glendine Billy
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden over hurdles; down the field in two 2026 outings; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, 14-race maiden over hurdles, down the field in two 2026 outings

runners.name: Goin'
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in Germany early in his career, and Listed-placed; can be rated a possible future hurdles winner based on Punchestown fifth last month on handicap debut; slight reservation now on account of a suspicion that he might prefer a longer trip.
runners.comment: Two Flat wins, can be rated a possible future hurdles winner based on Punchestown fifth

runners.name: Gold Gatewood
runners.spotlight: Ran three times in maidens in the first half of last year; no sign of worthwhile form.
runners.comment: Ran three times in maidens in the first half of last year, no sign of worthwhile form

runners.name: Wings Of Africa
runners.spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; beaten a long way in sixth in a 2m4f Limerick contest on handicap debut; hard to fancy
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in sixth in a 2m4f Limerick contest on handicap debut, hard to fancy

runners.name: Georginas Jet
runners.spotlight: Took a sharp rise in the ratings for a smooth Downpatrick win; met trouble when favourite at Bellewstown last week; her fourth placing (beaten 10l) can be upgraded a little.
runners.comment: Took a sharp rise in the ratings for a smooth Downpatrick win, met trouble at Bellewstown

runners.name: Notmiwadi
runners.spotlight: Nothing obvious in three maiden hurdle runs last year to suggest an immediate impact in handicaps.
runners.comment: Nothing obvious in three maiden runs last year to suggest an immediate impact in handicaps

races.race_name: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Love Like This
runners.spotlight: Running for the 45th time when opening her account with a C&D win last month; has gone up only 5lb , but probably vulnerable given her overall profile.
runners.comment: Running for the 45th time when opening her account with a C&D win, probably vulnerable

runners.name: Coppola
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in races at Down Royal (twice) and Downpatrick in March/April; struggled in first-time cheekpieces at this venue; same story when cheekpieces discarded for chase debut at Downpatrick; hard to be confident.
runners.comment: Second three times in the spring, doubts raised by failures at this venue and Downpatrick

runners.name: Down Around
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m4f at Thurles in 2024 for Philip Rothwell, his only success from 28 starts; placed nine times; in fair form before changing stables; market may provide clues to what is expected on his first start for Gordon Elliott.
runners.comment: Won over 2m4f for Philip Rothwell in 2024, in fair form before changing stable

runners.name: Island McCoo
runners.spotlight: Built on a promising second at Limerick when winning over C&D last month, his first hurdles win to add to a Tramore chase success; had a talented 7lb claimer aboard at Limerick, talented 5lb claimer this time.
runners.comment: Built on a promising second at Limerick when winning over C&D last month, stays well

runners.name: Georgia Celena
runners.spotlight: Her single win and all three places have come at Downpatrick; put in a pleasing effort when third there last month; however, overall form indicates she is not guaranteed to reproduce her best form elsewhere.
runners.comment: Her sole win/all three places have come at Downpatrick, a pleasing run there last month

runners.name: Knocknagoran Lady
runners.spotlight: Had plenty to spare when scoring a breakthrough win over an extended 2m6f at Limerick last week; a wind operation seems to have done the trick, and she is suited by good ground; can go well again off 9lb higher.
runners.comment: Had plenty to spare when scoring at Limerick last week, can go well again off 9lb higher

runners.name: Ballyglass Beauty
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in September 2022; last success was at Listowel the following year; at the veteran stage now; returned to form when second at Clonmel in April; flopped at Sligo in May, raising a doubt.
runners.comment: Veteran stays well, fine effort when second at Clonmel in April, flopped at Sligo in May

runners.name: Technology
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden over hurdles; best form at Wexford; fell at fifth in the race won by Knocknagoran Lady at Limerick last week.
runners.comment: 17-race maiden over hurdles, best form at Wexford, fell at fifth at Limerick last week

runners.name: Toor Moon
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 39 starts, placed 11 times; unseated in a chase on latest; not a betting proposition; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, maiden after 39 starts, placed 11 times, unseated in a chase on latest

runners.name: Tannery Park
runners.spotlight: Absent since scoring over an extended 2m6f at Ballinrobe early last season; an unknown quantity over this trip; placed over 2m on the Flat; fair chance of staying this far over hurdles at this circuit.
runners.comment: Absent since scoring at Ballinrobe early last season, first time beyond 2m6f, should stay

runners.name: Whatyouwant
runners.spotlight: Brought off an 80-1 shock over C&D last autumn when fitted with cheekpieces for the first time; after a lengthy break, she may have needed last week's race when a remote seventh behind Knocknagoran Lady at Limerick; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, brought off an 80-1 shock over C&D last autumn, may have needed recent run

runners.name: Another Glendaars
runners.spotlight: Single-figure odds on both starts for this stable after a long layoff; needs to raise his game, but possibly rash to ignore.
runners.comment: Single-figure odds on both starts for this stable, needs to raise his game, rash to ignore

runners.name: The Little Yank
runners.spotlight: Lost form drastically after a Clonmel win in January on the 101st outing of his career; pulled up on last four starts; Love Like This is yard's main hope.
runners.comment: Lost form drastically after a Clonmel win in January, Love Like This is yard's main hope

runners.name: Strong Contender
runners.spotlight: Weak maiden form; small step in the right direction in a C&D handicap last month; tongue-tie on now; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, weak maiden form, small step in the right direction in a C&D handicap

runners.name: Thewaybackhome
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a point; modest form in maiden hurdles; has made the frame in two Clonmel handicaps; cheekpieces on now; good 5lb claimer booked.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in two Clonmel handicaps, cheekpieces on now, good 5lb claimer booked

runners.name: Hay Baby
runners.spotlight: Hints of ability in handicap hurdles last year, and well backed on a few occasions; below par at Cork on final start before joining Emmet Mullins; the market may provide a guide.
runners.comment: Point winner, hints of winning potential, the market may provide a guide on stable debut

runners.name: Go Avel
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run at Limerick on her second run after a long break; reportedly bled at Downpatrick last time; never shorter than 25-1, and hard to fancy now.
runners.comment: Not a bad run at Limerick on her second run after a long break, reportedly bled last time
runners.owner: Mrs Peter Casey & Mrs Paula Casey

runners.name: Gypsy Poet
runners.spotlight: Signs of improvement in two handicap outings last October, notably when a staying-on sixth over a similar trip to this at Down Royal; half-brother to five Flat winners, including multiple Pattern scorer Tullius; should be more mature than when last seen; each-way prospect if fit.
runners.comment: Signs of improvement in two handicap outings last October, should be more mature now

runners.name: Sharetheknowledge
runners.spotlight: Maiden who looks capable of minor success judged on a pair of seconds in handicap hurdles at Clonmel in March and May last year; signed off 2025 with two fair runs in handicap chases; lack of a recent run is a possible negative.
runners.comment: Signed off 2025 with two fair runs in handicap chases, best hurdles form at Clonmel

races.race_name: Excell Supply EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive)

runners.name: Eighth Immortal
runners.spotlight: £40,000 breeze-up 2yo; couldn't hold off a strong finisher when 2-1 favourite on Leicester debut (7f, good) last month but he pulled clear of the third who was successful on his next outing; just about sets the standard on that form and he shaped as though this drop in trip could suit; strongly respected.
runners.comment: 2-1 favourite and he showed plenty of promise when runner-up at Leicester; key player

runners.name: Lincoln Warrior
runners.spotlight: Well held on Carlisle debut (5f, good) in May but he left that form a long way behind when runner-up over 6f at Wolverhampton (AW; 66-1) last month; that was a bold bid under a positive ride and he's a big player if he can build on that.
runners.comment: Left his debut form well behind when runner-up over 6f at Wolverhampton; shortlisted
runners.owner: Spg Property, Alfa Site & Graeme Curnow

runners.name: Maximus Meridius
runners.spotlight: 2,000gns breeze-up 2yo; attracted support into 15-2 at Ayr (6f, soft) last month and he finished runner-up behind an impressive winner; has wide draw on this switch to fast ground but that was a promising debut and he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Good second at Ayr (6f, soft) last month and has claims if he can build on that
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: True Charm
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise when runner-up at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May but he flopped at Nottingham 11 days later; that may have come too soon but he was beaten 12l in the end and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Showed clear promise on his Windsor debut but he flopped at Nottingham 11 days later

runners.name: Regency Royal
runners.spotlight: 55,000euros yearling; first foal; dam French 1m1f winner (Group-placed in Germany; RPR 88), half-sister to winners Rock My Love (1m 2yo Group 3), Rock My Soul (1m Listed), Run Wild (1m2f Listed) and Rock My Heart (1m Listed), out of 6f 2yo winner; interesting newcomer for yard that won this in 2018 and 2024.
runners.comment: 55,000euros yearling; interesting newcomer for yard that won this in 2018 and 2024

runners.name: Towelontheterrace
runners.spotlight: £10,000 breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to seven winners in Spain, including Abrantes (Group-placed 5f-6f); made an encouraging start when third over C&D (good to soft) last month but he was beaten 4l and that form has not really worked out; should know more this time but he needs a major step forward to make a serious impact.
runners.comment: Third on C&D debut last month but he was beaten 4l and that form has not really worked out

runners.name: Havana Cohiba
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns foal, £35,000 breeze-up 2yo; second foal; dam 6.6f 2yo winner (RPR 75), closely related to 7f 2yo winner Royal County Down, half-sister to winners Graymalkin (1m-1m2f including 2yo) and Airglow (5f/6f); has good target to aim at on debut and yard is not known for 2yo winners.
runners.comment: Has good target to aim at on debut and yard is not known for 2yo winners

runners.name: Hey Dougie
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 1m-1m2f AW winner (RPR 71), sister to 7f winner Future King, out of 7f winning half-sister to 1m Listed winner Flaming Spear; this looks a tough starting point and he's drawn out widest of all.
runners.comment: Out of 1m-1m2f AW winner; this looks a tough starting point and he's probably best watched

runners.name: Sydney Carton
runners.spotlight: 5-1 and did all his best work late on when third of eight on Beverley debut (7.5f, good to firm) last month; struggled when thrown in at the deep end in the Chesham at Royal Ascot but this looks another tough assignment on the figures and not sure this drop in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Struggled in the Chesham at Royal Ascot but this looks another tough task on the figures

runners.name: Soldier's Echo
runners.spotlight: Has a useful pedigree but she got outpaced before finishing seventh of 11 on her Bath debut (5.6f, firm; 12-1) last week; wasn't beaten far in that race but the form is modest and she needs major improvement on this step up to 6f.
runners.comment: No impact on her Bath debut last month and she needs major improvement upped in trip

runners.name: Profitability
runners.spotlight: 28-1 and she finished a remote fifth of nine on Haydock debut (6f, good to soft) in May; passed over.
runners.comment: 28-1 and she finished a remote fifth of nine on Haydock debut (6f, good to soft) in May
runners.owner: Peter Onslow & Mr & Mrs Gary Middlebrook

runners.name: Akaraka
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; Ghaiyyath colt out of a French/Spanish Listed-placed 10.7f-1m4f winner (98); weak 13-2 shot at Leicester (7f, good) last month and he never got involved before finishing seventh of nine; has a lot to find on this drop in trip and he could be a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: Made a low-key start at Leicester last month and he has a lot to find on this drop in trip

runners.name: Court Legend
runners.spotlight: RPRs in the 50s when down the field in a York seller (6f, good) and a Thirsk novice (6f, good to firm); has a lot to find on the figures and nurseries will be more suitable.
runners.comment: RPRs in the 50s when down the field in a York seller and a Thirsk novice

races.race_name: Moxy Chester EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Crownright
runners.spotlight: All starts over 1m; ran to a useful level in three runs in maiden/novice company; beaten 8l into ninth last time but that was the Sandringham Stakes at Royal Ascot; likely to stay this far and she's a leading contender; hood returns today.
runners.comment: Ninth in hot Royal Ascot handicap latest; major player now upped to 1m2f; hood returns

runners.name: Summerson
runners.spotlight: Mixed messages from her pedigree regarding this trip but there was clear promise amidst inexperience on her debut at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) and her late headway offered hope she would stay; much respected.
runners.comment: Promising 2nd at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) on debut; new trip worth exploring; unexposed

runners.name: Brighton Beach
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise when fifth of eight on her debut at Haydock (1m, good to firm) 11 weeks ago; should have plenty more to come now her stamina is being more fully tested.
runners.comment: Promise over 1m on debut in April; stepping up to 1m2f should suit; more to come

runners.name: Star Baby
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 1m events this season; bred to stay this far and do better but others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 1m runs this year; bred to stay but needs a big step forward

runners.name: Cash Cove
runners.spotlight: New Bay filly who showed promise in her first two starts but her form really took off when beating 12 rivals at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month; showed a good attitude in that race and she's strongly respected off what looks a fair mark on this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Beat 12 rivals at Doncaster and she looks on fair mark for this nursery debut; big player

runners.name: Donegal Rose
runners.spotlight: Promising fifth on Leicester debut (5f, good to firm) in April and she built on that with a strong-finishing success in a maiden here (5.5f, good) the following month; returns after a break but she's closely related to a 7f 2yo winner and is open to more progress on this step up in trip; in the mix on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Won with a strong finish over 5.5f here in May; in the mix upped to 7f on nursery debut

runners.name: Persian Land
runners.spotlight: Made winning debut at Haydock (6f, soft) in May; went down fighting when runner-up at Ffos Las (7.3f, good to soft) two weeks later but he was disappointing with visor added at Beverley last time; the headgear is now removed but opening mark looks on the high side and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Haydock winner but he flopped at Beverley (7.4f. good) last time and others are preferred

runners.name: Kach Above
runners.spotlight: Big improvement upped to 7f on his third start when justifying favouritism in a Leicester maiden (good) last month; has more to do now switched to a nursery but that was a comfortable success and he's bred to be useful; respected.
runners.comment: Comfortable winner of a Leicester maiden (7f) last month; respected on nursery debut

runners.name: King's Prize
runners.spotlight: Well backed into 4-1 for Nottingham debut (6f, good) in April and she stayed on strongly to win in good style; finished in rear in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) but she never got a clear run and it's not hard to put a line through that; looks interesting now switched to a nursery and this step up in trip should suit on pedigree.
runners.comment: Won on Nottingham debut and she didn't get any luck in the Albany; interesting contender
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: The Ginger Kid
runners.spotlight: 110,000euros yearling; his standout effort from three runs so far was a win at Nottingham (6f, good) last month but he had a tough task in the Coventry at Royal Ascot last time; failed to beat a rival in that race but he's back in calmer waters now and could resume his progress at this new trip; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Had tough task in the Coventry and he could resume his progress at this new trip

runners.name: Zgharta
runners.spotlight: Held her own in some hot handicaps after winning Newmarket maiden (1m2f, good) in May 2025 but has not really fired on either start this season; will appreciate this ease in grade but needs to up her game.
runners.comment: Will appreciate this ease in grade but has not really fired on either start this season

runners.name: Infraad
runners.spotlight: Well-bred colt who delivered on earlier promise when readily drawing clear to justify odds-on favouritism in Pontefract novice (1m2f, good) in April, his third run; makes handicap debut after ten-week break but should still have a fair bit more to offer; respected.
runners.comment: Readily drew clear to win Pontefract novice in April; has more to offer in handicaps

runners.name: Patagonia Girl
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) just under a year ago and was also on target over the extended 1m4f here (good) in May; not quite at same level when fifth of eight over C&D a fortnight ago but there were some mitigating circumstances and she remains of interest.
runners.comment: Dual course winner; not quite at best here a fortnight ago but still considered

runners.name: Let's Dream
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with big-field win at York (1m2f, good) in the autumn and posted another career-best performance when leading close home over C&D (good) on reappearance outing in May; ought to have been suited by the good to soft ground when well beaten in valuable Espom handicap on Oaks day but still enters calculations on return to this track.
runners.comment: Well beaten in valuable Epsom race last time but won over C&D two runs ago

runners.name: Gonna Fly
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who won tactical, three-runner Windsor novice (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 2-3; contests much deeper race on this handicap debut but probably still has potential.
runners.comment: Won tactical, three-runner novice last month and is now 2-3; makes handicap debut

runners.name: Nolton Cross
runners.spotlight: 6-24 on AW but 0-12 on turf; recent efforts have been underwhelming and he's probably better suited by 1m4f; not the percentage call.
runners.comment: 6-24 on AW but 0-12 on turf, and recent efforts have been underwhelming

runners.name: Wahdan
runners.spotlight: Very useful 3yo when based in France; largely disappointing for Joseph O'Brien in Ireland last year but started off for Tim Easterby with two encouraging runs at York (1m2f/1m) last month and has possibilities here.
runners.comment: Started off for new stable with two encouraging York runs last month; a possible

runners.name: King's Code
runners.spotlight: Took form to new level when collecting good prize on AW in January, his 14th career success; below best on turf lately but might be perked up by a change of headgear here and is too well handicapped to rule out.
runners.comment: Prolific winner; needs to better recent efforts but too well handicapped to rule out

runners.name: Aces Wild
runners.spotlight: Course win (5f, good) last July; arrives in top form, winning Class 5 events at Bath and Newbury (5f, firm and good to firm) this summer; 2lb rise shouldn't prevent another bold bid.
runners.comment: Course winner who arrives chasing a hat-trick; another big run on the cards

runners.name: Ran Amok
runners.spotlight: Underwent a wind operation after his seasonal return in May and he has run good races in both starts since, second over 6f here (good to soft) and then third at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; back up in class today but not discounted.
runners.comment: Two good placed efforts since a wind op; should remain competitive

runners.name: Rosenpur
runners.spotlight: Ideally suited by going around a left-hand bend, with his six wins coming here and at Wolverhampton; 10lb higher than for his win in this race last year and the widest draw isn't a big selling point today; cheekpieces join the hood today.
runners.comment: Won this race off 10lb lower last year; in good form but the widest stall adds difficulty

runners.name: Top Juggler
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who has run two good races at Hamilton (6f, good and 5f, good to soft) this season; unraced on faster than good but a key player if underfoot conditions are suitable.
runners.comment: Two good runs at Hamilton this year; drawn well for a prominent racer; contender

runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Ended losing run with an emphatic success at Wolverhampton (5f) six weeks ago and the runner-up has done his bit for the form since; still seeking a first turf win though and following up off 7lb higher won't be easy.
runners.comment: Comfortable win at Wolverhampton in May; 0-10 on turf and 7lb rise asks more to boot

runners.name: Supreme King
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a lowly mark at Southwell in December and he has flourished since, adding two more AW wins over the winter and going in again at Salisbury (6f, soft) last month; second in two fast-ground handicaps since; should remain competitive but this test will be sharp enough.
runners.comment: In fine form since December, winning 4 times; runner-up on last two starts; solid claims

runners.name: Changeofmind
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways with his Class 5 win at Pontefract (5f, good to soft) in May; respectable efforts twice since but he would be more appealing on slower ground.
runners.comment: Class 5 win in May and two fair efforts since; would be more appealing on slower ground

runners.name: Betsen
runners.spotlight: Two wins since joining Tony Carroll, the latest a small-field Class 4 at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) in May; solid effort from a less-than-ideal draw in the Epsom Dash five weeks ago; not discounted back down in class.
runners.comment: Solid effort from less-than-ideal draw in the Epsom Dash; respected back down in class

runners.name: Berkshire Boom
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden (good) last July but he's been well held in three handicaps this season including over 7.6f here (soft) last month; still lightly raced but he needs to rediscover his spark back on quicker ground.
runners.comment: Won a C&D maiden last July but he's been well held in three handicaps this season
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Alfa Whiteburd
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner who returned to form on his second run after wind surgery when a front-running second at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) last month; record of 0-14 on turf but he's 6lb lower than last time and is well handicapped on his second at York last spring; respected.
runners.comment: Went close at Southwell last month and he's 6lb lower back on turf; respected

runners.name: Imelda
runners.spotlight: Placed at Wolverhampton in her first two starts this spring and same story when third in a C&D maiden (good) in May; should have more to offer now switched to a handicap but this opening mark is no gift and she's not had much luck with the draw.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly but opening mark is no gift and she's not had much luck with the draw

runners.name: How Impressive
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner but sole turf win was in 2023 and he was tailed off back in this sphere at Catterick (7f, good) in May; has something to prove after another break and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Sole turf win was in 2023 and he was tailed off back in this sphere at Catterick in May

runners.name: Mister McGregor
runners.spotlight: 0-26 but he's been runner-up five times and was a creditable third in a maiden handicap at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; could be in the mix again but he has some work to do from 3lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo but he's still a maiden and has some work to do from out of the weights

runners.name: Black Rock Beauty
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough with cheekpieces added at Redcar (7f, good) in May and he backed that up with a close third of 15 at Doncaster last month; up another 2lb but he still has low mileage and is open to more progress in 7f handicaps; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar (7f, good) and he backed that up with a close third at Doncaster; respected

runners.name: Trust Sergei
runners.spotlight: Not a straightforward customer but he got back on the scoresheet with a last-gasp success at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) 12 days ago; has a penalty but he won off a higher mark at Doncaster last spring and he looks worth another try at this trip; dangerous.
runners.comment: Got back on the scoresheet with last-gasp win at Wolverhampton; in the mix back up in trip

runners.name: Carolus Magnus
runners.spotlight: Recorded his fourth turf win when making all over 7f at Musselburgh (good) 18 days ago; has wide draw on his belated Chester debut but he's only 2lb higher than last time and is a player if he can repeat that form.
runners.comment: Won at Musselburgh latest and he's only 2lb higher here; in the mix, despite wide draw

runners.name: Montpellier Green
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Joseph O'Brien but he struggled last season at trips ranging from 5f to 2m; has dropped a long way in the weights but he's now 1-16 and needs a major revival after 202 days off.
runners.comment: On reduced mark but he struggled last season and needs a major revival on his return

runners.name: Kitaab
runners.spotlight: No win since October 2024 but he's on a reduced mark and showed signs of a revival when fourth at Thirsk (6f, good; 11-1) last month; has possibilities if he can build on that and he's effective at this trip.
runners.comment: Showed signs of a revival at Thirsk and has possibilities if he can build on that

runners.name: Law Of Design
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 13 starts was in a four-runner novice at Ascot (7f, soft) in September 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he's been well held in his last five runs and has something to prove after another break.
runners.comment: Sole win was in September 2024 and he's been well held in last five runs; passed over

runners.name: Kings Merchant
runners.spotlight: Gained all four wins over sprint trips, the latest in September 2024; ran quite well over 7f at Catterick (good) in May, though, and nearly exploited this career-low mark at Doncaster (6f, good to firm; second run in cheekpieces) a week ago; due to go back up 3lb; must be considered.
runners.comment: On lengthy losing run but 3lb well in after going close over 6f last week

runners.name: Giant
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner; 0-10 on turf but has made the frame off today's mark twice in recent weeks (6f/7f, good to firm) and has good draw here; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: 0-10 on turf but twice in the frame off today's mark lately (6f/7f) and has good draw

runners.name: Pearly Squirrel
runners.spotlight: Third at Newbury (1m, good) on latest turf start in May and also ran well when filling same position at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) 12 days ago but wide draw makes things awkward here.
runners.comment: Placed off this mark on AW recently but wide draw makes things awkward here

runners.name: Triggerman
runners.spotlight: 1-20 for Julie Camacho, the win gained over 1m on Tapeta in September 2024; makes stable debut from workable mark and with trip/ground suitable but absent since two below-par AW runs in the winter.
runners.comment: Makes stable debut from workable mark but absent since two below-par AW runs in winter

runners.name: Currahee
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f winner last summer (good to firm/AW); made low-key seasonal debut over 6f last month and not ideally drawn here but still quite lightly raced, and that recent outing ought to have brought him on.
runners.comment: Dual 7f winner last summer; made low-key return over 6f but may come on for the run
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Sparkling Pink
runners.spotlight: Placed at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in April and might have been stretched by 1m when respectable fourth at Redcar (good) last month but has mixed record for this stable since September and is drawn on the outside.
runners.comment: Placed over this trip in April but not very consistent, and has the outside draw

runners.name: El Pinto
runners.spotlight: A maiden after nine runs but has gradually worked his way back to form this season and kept on pretty well for third at Carlisle (7f, good) last month; could have a say.
runners.comment: 0-9 but kept on pretty well for third at Carlisle last month; could have a say

runners.name: Top Lad
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; placed over 7f on soft ground as a 2yo but was always behind on seasonal/handicap debut at Beverley (7.4f, good to soft) in April and will need a much more dynamic performance here.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden; always behind on seasonal/handicap debut in April

runners.name: Yoko
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly, absent since second of four behind well-handicapped rival on nursery debut at Ffos Las (6f, good) just under a year ago; up in trip for stable debut (same owner); well drawn; market helpful.
runners.comment: Absent since second of four on nursery debut last summer (6f); now with new stable

runners.name: King Of War
runners.spotlight: Habitual front-runner; reeled in after going off a bit too hard over 1m at Brighton recently but won over 7f there (good to firm) two starts ago and has the ideal draw here; could take some catching.
runners.comment: Habitual front-runner; won at Brighton last month and has the perfect draw here

runners.name: Hygge
runners.spotlight: Popped up at 20-1 on Flat debut in 1m maiden at Killarney (second won twice since); filled same position in all four hurdle outings previously, including C&D contest on yielding ground in April; beaten 22l on that occasion, but that has turned out to be strong form.
runners.comment: Flat winner was beaten 22l over C&D in April, but that has turned out to be strong form

runners.name: Monntie
runners.spotlight: Rated 63 after three Flat runs for the Hartys; 50s, good start over hurdles when second at Bellewstown; well beaten by 123-rated winner, with a pair of experienced, if disappointing, types behind her.
runners.comment: 50s, good start over hurdles when second at Bellewstown, well beaten by 123-rated winner

runners.name: Saporetti
runners.spotlight: Winner over 1m4f in France; fair fifth over C&D on Irish debut in March; his 12l third to smart Switch For Diesel in 5-runner Punchestown novice likely flatters him a good deal.
runners.comment: Fair fifth over C&D on Irish debut; his 12l third to smart type likely flatters him

runners.name: Good Onya Mate
runners.spotlight: Australia gelding out of a half-sister to smart dual-purpose performer Wicklow Brave; second off 65 over 1m6f at Gowran is his best Flat run; hurdling debut and looks a second-string for yard.
runners.comment: Second off 65 over 1m6f at Gowran his best Flat run; hurdling debut
runners.owner: P J Morgan & Mrs S L Morgan

runners.name: I'm All In
runners.spotlight: Not big prices but jumping issues all starts, including a last-flight departure when looking booked for second here in November; back from a break and gets better ground.
runners.comment: Not big prices but jumping issues all starts; back from a break and gets better ground

runners.name: Absolutley Fab
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word filly; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, half-sister to four winners over jumps.
runners.comment: Poet's Word filly; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, half-sister to four winners over jumps

runners.name: Moonwing
runners.spotlight: Wings Of Eagles newcomer is out of an unraced sister to the high-class Ballyburn.
runners.comment: Wings Of Eagles newcomer is out of an unraced sister to the high-class Ballyburn

runners.name: Oops A Daisy
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in two bumpers in May; second-string for the 'Shark'.
runners.comment: Tailed off in two bumpers in May; second-string for the 'Shark'.

runners.name: Landamar
runners.spotlight: By The Irish Rover; dam won a point, and is out of unraced sister to winners Abbey Glen (2m-3m hurdle) and Whisper Rock (bumper/2m-2m2f hurdle/chase).
runners.comment: By The Irish Rover; dam won a point and is out of unraced sister to 2m/3m hurdles winner

runners.name: Pinkarizon
runners.spotlight: 65-rated Flat maiden in Britain; burst on stable/hurdling debut.
runners.comment: 65-rated Flat maiden in Britain; burst on stable/hurdling debut.

runners.name: Who's Da Goose
runners.spotlight: Fair runs in two maidens, beaten 37l and 33l, but unlikely to be ready to strike yet.
runners.comment: Fair runs in two maidens, beaten 37l and 33l, but unlikely to be ready to strike yet

runners.name: Mambo Du Large
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in first two maidens; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten in first two maidens; tongue-tie

runners.name: Mont Star
runners.spotlight: Nice jumping pedigree and was second over 11.5f in France last year; only 7-2 for Punchestown maiden in November, well beaten on testing ground, but could be a different proposition on a sounder surface.
runners.comment: Only 7-2 for Punchestown maiden, well beaten on testing ground; sounder surface will help
runners.owner: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan

runners.name: Pillartou
runners.spotlight: Only 4s when pulled up in a point; beaten 45l in first hurdles outing; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Only 4s when pulled up in a point; beaten 45l in first hurdles outing; tongue-tie

races.race_name: DNG John Ryan Auctioneer Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Cosmos d'Ainay
runners.spotlight: Point winner who posted a useful RPR in winning a Sligo bumper; beaten 24l and 16l in two runs over hurdles, which were backward steps; has been off for 11 months, but that might not matter all that much and it's still early days for him.
runners.comment: Bumper winner; backward steps over hurdles but still early days; off 11 months

runners.name: Minella Post
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise in 2024, in bumpers and maidens; his comeback run was disappointing but that was after a long absence and in a useful handicap at Punchestown; now has his tongue tied; disappointing if he doesn't leave that run behind.
runners.comment: Has some useful form but was quiet in a handicap following an absence; now tongue tied

runners.name: It's All Clear
runners.spotlight: Positives to take from his bumper runs and again when third of 15 on hurdle debut at Clonmel (2m, good; first-time tongue-tie); has to enter the equation in a race of this nature.
runners.comment: Positives to take from his bumper runs and again when third of 15 on hurdle debut
runners.owner: Paul M O'Loughlin & W D Gannon

runners.name: Cloonbonniffe
runners.spotlight: Best run was the 11l defeat in a maiden at Sligo, since when he's finished well behind in a bumper; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Best run was the 11l defeat in a Sligo maiden, since when he's finished behind in a bumper

runners.name: Lucky Vick
runners.spotlight: Not a bad first run over hurdles when beaten under 10l at Limerick (2m, yielding; 50-1); that form brings him into this.
runners.comment: Not a bad first run over hurdles when beaten under 10l at Limerick

runners.name: Gc Star Speed

runners.name: Jay Pee M

runners.name: El Regalo
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in a low-grade 1m5f handicap a month ago (blinkers returned) and there has been the odd bit of promise in handicap hurdles; 0-16 under both codes, but no forlorn hope here.

runners.name: Miss Gitana
runners.spotlight: Flat wins in Britain and when with Gordon Elliott, for whom she went 0-9 over hurdles; has looked regressive on the Flat this year.

runners.name: Dictionary Corner

runners.name: Lunar Landscape
runners.spotlight: 0-19 but only raced four times over hurdles and wasn't disgraced on handicap hurdle debut at Wexford (beaten 10l; 2m1f, good to yielding).

runners.name: Drumadeise

runners.comment: Insufficient promise in maidens to believe she'll make an instant splash in handicaps

runners.spotlight: Point winner who was runner-up in a bumper; not so good over hurdles, but that could change now handicapping and he might enjoy this nicer ground.
runners.comment: Point winner who was runner-up in a bumper; lesser hurdle form but now handicapping

runners.name: Maxicourt
runners.spotlight: One notable run in a maiden last year, but that's beginning to look extremely flattering; no real form in handicaps.

runners.name: Eaglewood
