runners.comment: By Irish St Leger winner Flag Of Honour; half-sister to point/2m4f hurdle winner

runners.name: Highland Call
runners.spotlight: By Highland Reel out of unraced mare; sister to smart 1m4f winner Highland Bling and half-sister to two other winners.
runners.comment: Highland Reel sister to smart 1m4f winner Highland Bling, half-sister to two other winners

runners.name: Hilly Filly
runners.spotlight: By Affinisea out of 2m4f hurdles winner; half-sister to useful bumper winner Fascile Mode (also won over hurdles and fences); scratched due to soft ground a month ago.
runners.comment: By Affinisea out of 2m4f hurdle winner; half-sister to useful bumper winner Fascile Mode

runners.name: I'm Gold
runners.spotlight: By Order Of St George; dam runner-up in only point start, half-sister to smart bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Black Tears.
runners.comment: By Order Of St George out of half-sister to smart bumper and hurdle winner Black Tears

runners.name: Not A Whisper
runners.spotlight: By Elusive Pimpernel; half-sister to winners Not Staying Long (2m3f-3m1f hurdle/chase), Barden Bella (2m-3m3f chase), Track And Trace (2m5f-3m6f hurdle/chase inc US) and Hard Dealt (point/2m4f hurdle); dam half-sister to useful jumpers Sempo and Aqua Dude; yard 10-96 in bumpers last five seasons, rider yet to score.
runners.comment: Elusive Pimpernel half-sister to four jumps winners; yard 10-96 in bumpers last 5 seasons

runners.name: Tiger In New York
runners.spotlight: Homebred by Capri; dam unraced half-sister to German 1m3f/1m7f winner; yard going well but wouldn't be known for bumper winners.
runners.comment: Homebred by Capri; dam unraced half-sister to German 1m3f/1m7f winner; yard going well

runners.name: Lavender Berry
runners.spotlight: 40s, tailed off at Listowel in May.
runners.comment: 40, tailed off at Listowel in May.

races.race_name: CopyBet Daily World Cup Profit Boost Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Evening Tess
runners.spotlight: Progress as a hurdler culminated in this month's Fontwell mares' novice win (2m3f, good); it's unlikely she'll be as free to dictate the pace again here, and there's already one handicap defeat off 9lb lower in her profile, but she gets the sizeable age allowance on this early switch to chasing.
runners.comment: Able to dictate when winning Fontwell novice hurdle latest (2m3f, good); chasing debut.

runners.name: Manowest
runners.spotlight: 2m7f maiden hurdle winner here (good) and overall Worcester record reads 2531; this shorter trip is likely still manageable here, although he was below form at sharp Southwell over nearly 2m5f on chasing debut last time (beaten 19l); fair claims off 2lb lower; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Sole hurdles win came here (2m7f); found Southwell too sharp on chase debut last time.

runners.name: Captain Boudet
runners.spotlight: Led but didn't over-race in the first-time visor on this month's stable debut here (good), the 2m7f trip appearing more the issue; 3f drop all to the good, likewise a mark back below his last winning one.
runners.comment: 2m7f trip appeared the issue on this month's stable debut; more in his favour here.

runners.name: Mix Of Clover
runners.spotlight: Hasn't always needed as many as two runs back to hit his straps, so arguably has a bit to prove now having posted only well-beaten thirds on his two starts this summer; has returned to his last winning mark, though.
runners.comment: Maybe a bit to prove now having underperformed on both recent starts; ground/mark fine.

runners.name: Aslukgoes
runners.spotlight: 2m bumper and maiden hurdle wins (good) among his course record of 121P; exited too far out on this month's Cartmel chase debut (2m5f) to know how close he'd have run the prolific Passengerontheship, but he was traveling easily at the time; remains of interest.
runners.comment: Bumper/hurdle winner here; still going well when unseating on Cartmel chase debut (good).

runners.name: Boskill Borden
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in 2m4f hurdle races here last summer (good) but ended last year's campaign on a low, achieving little on October's chasing debut; can't be certain he will hit the ground running in 2026.
runners.comment: Twice placed in 2m4f hurdles here last summer (good); ended last year's campaign on a low.

runners.name: White Riot
runners.spotlight: 2025 bumper winner (2m, good) but generally a weak finisher over hurdles since, even with a tongue-tie and after wind surgery; couldn't be confident about chase/handicap debut (Flat bred) despite respected connections.
runners.comment: Generally a weak finisher over hurdles; couldn't be confident about chase/handicap bow.

races.race_name: Amodil Group Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Edgewell
runners.spotlight: Logged a third chase win this year when keeping on well at Newton Abbot last month (3m2f, good); at least one race per month since November speaks to his resilience, but it's noticeable that he's been kept to sharp tracks since pulling up at Exeter eight months ago.
runners.comment: Newton Abbot winner latest (3m2f, good); would likely prefer sharper track than Worcester.

runners.name: Ridin Solo
runners.spotlight: First start since November when finding only a rival completing a hat-trick too good at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good); still early days over fences and this longest trip since landing an Irish point is worth a go.
runners.comment: Good second to a thriving rival on last month's seasonal return; longer trip worth a go.

runners.name: Getaway Vic
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner here and elsewhere in 2024-25 (good); just gently progressive in defeat in novice/maiden hurdles since over a year out, but chaser-laden pedigree (family of Our Vic) offers hope that he'll prove somewhat better over fences, as well he must granted an ungenerous initial mark.
runners.comment: Course bumper winner; pedigree offers abundant hope for the switch to fences.

runners.name: Always Busy
runners.spotlight: Stamina to spare at tonight's trip, and he's representing last year's race-winning trainer and rider combination; never especially consistent, however, and last month's Hexham disappointment as favourite took his chasing strike-rate to 2-16; unclear what to expect.
runners.comment: Stamina to spare, but it's unclear what to expect after a below-par effort latest.

runners.name: Grillon De Monty
runners.spotlight: Easy to disregard latest Stratford outing (rider lost irons early) but form of his previous second there has a shaky look to it; remains 7lb higher than for the second of two C&D wins last summer (good).
runners.comment: Rider lost irons early last time; remains 7lb higher than for the second of two C&D wins.

runners.name: Doyouknowwhatimean
runners.spotlight: Three places and 59l ahead of Betty's Tiara over C&D last week (good), though still well held himself and simply isn't coming very close at present to recording a first win beyond 2m1f; 5lb badly in compared to future mark.
runners.comment: Well clear of Betty's Tiara over C&D last week but below a winning level himself.

races.race_name: Amodil Group Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Kiwi de Cotte
runners.spotlight: Defied market opposition to run away with a 3m Market Rasen maiden on British/hurdling debut three weeks ago (good), with Saint Arion over 20l adrift; all or nothing profile in Ireland beforehand so no cast-iron certainty to back that up, but this race doesn't appear any stronger.
runners.comment: Easy Market Rasen winner on British/hurdling debut (3m, good); found another good opening.

runners.name: Regarde
runners.spotlight: Either or both the class 2 company and drop back to 3m compromised him in Uttoxeter's Summer Cup latest (blinkers debuted there retained); untried over today's even shorter trip since November 2023 and over hurdles for longer still, so hard to see how this assignment plays to many strengths.
runners.comment: Pulled up in Uttoxeter's Summer Cup latest; untried over 2m4f or hurdles since 2023.

runners.name: Yellow Card
runners.spotlight: Converted a realistic opportunity at Newton Abbot latest (2m6f, good) for a first hurdling win in five tries; penalty demands more, but a tidier round of jumping than any to date could unlock further improvement.
runners.comment: Converted good opportunity at Newton Abbot latest (2m6f); can upgrade if jumping better.

runners.name: Saint Arion
runners.spotlight: Outpaced fourth over 2m here in May and a clear non-stayer of a mile longer at Market Rasen since (20l to find with Kiwi De Cotte on that showing), so intermediate trip makes total sense; does need to jump better.
runners.comment: 20l to find with Kiwi De Cotte on last-time Market Rasen clash (3m); could jump better.

runners.name: Solo Eclipse
runners.spotlight: Regressive RPRs since a Huntingdon bumper debut second (soft), beaten by halfway over 2m here latest; return to 2m4f isn't persuasive.
runners.comment: Gone the wrong way since bumper debut second (soft); soon in trouble here latest (2m).
runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson

runners.name: Geordie Mackem
runners.spotlight: Didn't kick on once switched to the Flat following initial promise in bumpers for Brian Ellison; sold for 6,000gns since last run; out of a Listed winner over this sort of trip, but new yard does most of its winning in handicaps.
runners.comment: Didn't carry initial bumper promise over to the Flat; one for handicaps later; yard debut.

runners.name: Annual Invitation
runners.spotlight: Essentially improving with practice over hurdles, albeit drawing the ire of the stewards in posting a 24l fifth at Uttoxeter latest (2m, good); more appeal in moderate handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Getting better with practice, albeit incurring the wrath of the stewards last time out.

runners.name: Virtuose d'Ainay
runners.spotlight: Fair third on sole Irish point start three years ago, but no evidence much ability remains on just three hurdles starts since.
runners.comment: Fair third on sole Irish point start three years ago; no promise in three starts since.

runners.name: Tufton
runners.spotlight: Promising March 2025 point bumper third (good), but hasn't lasted home in any run beyond 2m1f; needs 249-day break to have brought him on.
runners.comment: Not yet a stayer beyond 2m1f; needs to have derived benefit from his eight-month break.

runners.name: Ebony Warrior
runners.spotlight: Worcester record of 3122U1 includes last month's 2m7f win off 6lb lower (good); no margin for error back on his highest mark, but place claims if now able to return to the consistency of his 2024-25 campaign.
runners.comment: 2m7f winner off 6lb lower here last time (good); claims if running to that level again.
runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson

runners.name: Our Guide
runners.spotlight: Bidding to emulate stablemate Handlethekettle, who took the same C&D 0-140 as him last year before going on to add this race; 4lb rise for that latest win leaves him with nothing in hand on peak RPRs and he could still jump better, but there's nothing halfway as progressive in opposition.
runners.comment: Last-time C&D 0-140 scorer; could still jump better, but his are strong claims otherwise.

runners.name: American Mike
runners.spotlight: Tom Hutsby was also up and claiming 10lb when nailed on the line here last month in a 2m7f class 3 that was no worse a race than this; respected, for all that hurdles mark has never higher following a 3lb raise; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Nailed on the line over 2m7f here latest (good); hurdles mark now at its highest ever.

runners.name: Miss Maverick
runners.spotlight: Last five wins have all been gained over 2m4f, but three defeats since May's latest Uttoxeter success (her fifth there) have taken her score to 0-4 racing off marks in the 120s; rivalry for early lead.
runners.comment: Trip/ground fine; still high in weights; faces pace rivalry from such as Skyjack Hijack.

runners.name: Dream Diamond
runners.spotlight: 2m maiden win here last August (good) remains his only success in 11 over hurdles; debuted hood (retained here) possibly behind a better round of jumping than he sometimes manages around sharp tracks when going close off today's mark at Newton Abbot last month; place claims in same mood.
runners.comment: 2m maiden winner last summer; went close in a debuted hood (retained here) last time.

runners.name: Billy Boi Blue
runners.spotlight: Generally fast-weakening efforts since returning from a winter break, so the recourse to wind surgery is unsurprising; mark never lower, but effectiveness down at 2m4f hasn't been tested since March 2024.
runners.comment: Weighted to strike if wind surgery works, but no starts over this short since March 2024.

runners.name: Skyjack Hijack
runners.spotlight: Front-runner whose 2024 six-timer came over longer trips than today's; no evidence in three runs since a 14-month absence that he retains sufficient ability to figure here; gains cheekpieces and a tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Struggling to find sufficient form since returning from 14 months out; prefers further.

races.race_name: Martin Keighley Racing Club Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: The Secret Pearl
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped if judged on her two 2m4f seconds at the end of last year but not firing on all cylinders in recent months; well held when third in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) at Market Rasen (2m, good) three weeks ago; needs to up her game.
runners.comment: Well handicapped if judged on late-2025 form but needs to better recent efforts

runners.name: Play Pretend
runners.spotlight: Returned from break with two low-key runs this spring but looked back in good nick when third here (2m, good) last month and will be fine over today's longer trip; one to consider.
runners.comment: Back in good nick when placed over 2m here last month and this longer trip also suits

runners.name: Little Ledgend
runners.spotlight: Made jockey work hard and was no threat to winner when keeping on to snatch second from Estacas at Market Rasen (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month and now 0-8 over hurdles; however, that was his first run since February and he's probably still on a workable mark; big player if he travels more sweetly in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: No threat to winner when keeping-on second last month but that run came after a break

runners.name: Bells Of Ufford
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles but seemingly aided by tongue-tie on last two appearances, more recently when clear second at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month; competes off same mark here and enters calculations.
runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles but clear second at Uttoxeter last month and competes off same mark here

runners.name: Strong As Steel
runners.spotlight: Well beaten here (2m, good) last month, after a break, and has now been unplaced all nine hurdle starts; might come on for the run but others have much more obvious claims; 1lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Well beaten here last month, after a break, and now 0-9 over hurdles

runners.name: Estacas
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for second over C&D (good; refitted cheekpieces) behind well-handicapped rival in May, his second stable start, and ran another big race at Market Rasen (2m4f, good) last month, albeit weakening on run-in and losing second to Little Ledgend close home; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Good second over C&D in May and again ran well last month; high on the list

runners.name: Mancero
runners.spotlight: Opened British account under strong ride over C&D (good) in May and has obvious claims if judged on that performance but already looked beaten when badly hampered at third-last hurdle at Market Rasen last month and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: C&D winner under strong ride in May but well beaten on latest outing; needs to rebound

runners.name: North Account
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only five starts (one in a point) but was soundly beaten on recent stable/handicap debut at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) and needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Remains unexposed but was soundly beaten on recent stable/handicap debut

runners.name: Idaho Fire
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on first two hurdling starts for Paul Nicholls but seemed to be getting his act together when close third of five at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) in May; subsequently changed hands for £21,000; open to significant further progress in handicaps for new stable.
runners.comment: Pulled up first two hurdle starts but latest run was much better; stable/handicap debut

races.race_name: Martin Keighley Racing Club Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Scintillante
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m course winner in early part of last season; has mixed record since and is not yet proven over this far but seemed to have benefited from a wind operation when close third of five here (2m, good) last month.
runners.comment: Mixed record since two course wins in early part of last season but ran well last month

runners.name: Lacrima
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo; began British career with some disappointing hurdle/chase runs this spring but drew clear to score by 7l here (2m7f hurdle, good) nine days ago; escapes a penalty for that and is 8lb ahead of the handicapper; makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Avoids a penalty for last week's 7l course win (2m7f); makes obvious appeal

runners.name: Faded Fantasy
runners.spotlight: Won twice last summer (2m7f/3m2f) but returned from a break with two disappointing runs last month (both 2m7f) and this drop back in trip is not an obvious move.
runners.comment: Twice well beaten over 2m7f last month and this drop back in trip is not an obvious move

runners.name: Boston Savr
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on handicap debut (2m4f; wore cheekpieces) in February and probably didn't achieve a great deal when sixth at Southwell (3m, good; blinkered) last month but remains lightly raced and may yet burst into life.
runners.comment: Began handicap career with two low-key runs (2m4f/3m) but may yet burst into life

runners.name: Bashful Boy
runners.spotlight: Without a win since 2023 and was out of form when last seen over hurdles in the autumn; this year's Flat form has been fairly respectable but he's on the downgrade and makes only limited appeal back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Recent Flat form has been fairly respectable but he's on the downgrade; others preferred

runners.name: County Champs
runners.spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles in Ireland but but placed in big fields on four of his five starts in 2025; campaigned mainly at about 3m and may be better suited by ground slower than good but, having changed hands for £9,500 in April, it will be interesting to see what Chris Gordon can do with him.
runners.comment: 0-14 but placed several times in Ireland; makes stable debut after a break
runners.owner: The Les & Jan Gilbert Racing Legacy

runners.name: Could Be You
runners.spotlight: Dropped out and was beaten about 50l on stable/handicap debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) in April but remains unexposed and is worth keeping an eye on in the betting; had wind operation in May; tongue-tie removed after one use.
runners.comment: Beaten 50l on stable/handicap debut but remains unexposed; worth glance in betting

runners.name: Present Fair
runners.spotlight: Free-goer who won twice at Bangor last year (2m3f/2m7f); absent since consecutive heavy defeats last July/September, though, and returns with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Won twice last year but well beaten on last two outings; returns from ten-month break

runners.name: Harry Gulliver
runners.spotlight: Managed a win off lowly mark at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) in October 2024 but absent since heavy defeat the following month (albeit on slower-than-ideal ground) and entitled to benefit from this outing.
runners.comment: Won off lowly mark in October 2024 but absent since heavy defeat the following month

runners.name: Illico De Montave
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all nine hurdling starts and absent since safely held on consecutive 2m7f starts here last August; 7lb out of the handicap and needs September's wind operation to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Unplaced all nine hurdle runs and absent since last August; 7lb wrong; had wind op

runners.name: Best Night
runners.spotlight: Not one to rely upon that heavily but scored off today's mark at Huntingdon (2m, good) in March and creditable third of 14 at Stratford (2m, good to firm) 11 days ago; features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Creditable third of 14 at Stratford recently and remains on last winning mark

runners.name: Quick Of The Night
runners.spotlight: Well held when third at Warwick (2m, good) last month, after a break, but gained her wins in the last two editions of this race and is now 2lb lower than last year; likely to have been primed for a bold defence.
runners.comment: Won last two editions of this race and is likely to have been primed for a bold defence

runners.name: Lucy The Wire
runners.spotlight: Won against own age group on soft ground in the autumn and close second on handicap debut at Kempton (2m, good) in March; below that form behind Best Night at Stratford recently but might just have needed that outing and will be a threat if back on song in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Behind Best Night recently but might just have needed that run; now sports cheekpieces

runners.name: No Risk Today
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four hurdle runs but was safely held when upped to 2m4f for last month's handicap debut; drops back in trip in need of improvement.
runners.comment: Safely held when upped to 2m4f for handicap debut; back in trip in need of improvement

runners.name: Mistral Milly
runners.spotlight: Well beaten after racing too freely at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) in May and now 0-9 over hurdles; hasn't been with current stable long and may benefit from this drop back in trip but others look safer.
runners.comment: Well beaten after racing too freely last time and now 0-9 over hurdles
runners.owner: John Murray & Exor Of Late Niall Farrell

runners.name: Jukebox Annie
runners.spotlight: 1-11 over hurdles; returned from break with a quite encouraging fourth at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) last month and subsequent run may be best overlooked (pulled up after losing action in early stages) but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: Ran quite well last month, after a break, but others appeal more all the same

runners.name: Caterpillar Girl
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper in spring 2025 but has made a disappointing start to her jumping career; all three handicap runs were over fences, with two non-completions sandwiching a 33l defeat; reverts to hurdling with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Made disappointing start to chase career this spring; back hurdling with fair bit to prove

runners.name: Charlotte Square
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven hurdle starts and absent since pulled up twice here (2m4f/2m) for Ryan Potter last June; 14lb wrong for stable debut; can't be recommended.
runners.comment: Absent since pulled up twice here last summer and 14lb wrong for this stable debut

races.race_name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Hold Your Fort
runners.spotlight: Seven-time chase winner who developed into a useful performer last season; below form at Uttoxeter recently and tricky to weigh up over hurdles but still looks tempting, given he's 27lb lower in this sphere.
runners.comment: Useful chaser; tricky to weigh up over hurdles but his mark is 27lb lower in this sphere

runners.name: Spitalfield
runners.spotlight: Seemingly aided by cheekpieces when making the frame at Warwick twice this season (3m1f/3m2f, good) but his finishing was disappointing in those races and he's patently not as good as he was; others preferred.
runners.comment: Aided by cheekpieces when making frame on both starts this season but not the force of old

runners.name: Pooroldmackley
runners.spotlight: 2-13 over hurdles, the latter win gained off this mark over C&D (good) last summer; has lost his way a bit since, though, and was safely held off his lower chase mark last month; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Won off this mark over C&D last summer but has lost his way a bit since

runners.name: Stiletto
runners.spotlight: Won three times under Sean Bowen (once over C&D) in 2025; well below best on all four appearances this year but has slipped to a good mark and the champion jockey evidently still has faith in him; revival possible.
runners.comment: Three wins in 2025; well below best this year but a revival remains possible

runners.name: Oneinthewell
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but returned from a break with a pretty good second at Market Rasen (2m4f, good; refitted cheekpieces) on Sunday and is quickly back in action before handicapper has chance to nudge him up the weights; unexposed as a stayer; likely contender.
runners.comment: 0-8 over hurdles but returned from a break with a pretty good second on Sunday (2m4f)

runners.name: Mexican Stan
runners.spotlight: Came good at Warwick (3m1f, good) in May, his seventh start over hurdles, but beaten about 11l when fourth on next two outings (one over C&D) and needs to kick on again.
runners.comment: Came good at Warwick in May but held off new mark twice since; needs to kick on again

runners.name: Jefe Triunfo
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when upped to 3m at Southwell (good) last month but generally disappointing in handicaps since winning a 2m maiden in spring 2025; first-time visor needs to give him a boost.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly when upped to 3m last month but needs a boost from new visor here

runners.name: Fane Court
runners.spotlight: 0-6 under rules; struggled on chasing debut in March but made a promising stable debut when fourth over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month and will probably be suited by this move back up in trip; a possible.
runners.comment: Made promising stable debut (2m4f) and will probably be suited by the move back up in trip

runners.name: Ballela Blaze
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but was making first appearance for 13 months when keeping on for third at Southwell (2m4f, good) in May and is sure to be suited by this move back up in trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Kept on for third over 2m4f in May, after a long layoff, and this longer trip will suit

runners.name: Alderley Charlie
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles and 0-12 overall; ended string of dismal efforts and travelled well for a long way when clear second at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) in May but is effectively 6lb higher from out of the weights here.
runners.comment: Ended string of dismal runs with Ffos Las second in May but is 4lb wrong here

runners.name: Iamcelestialgift
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m3f on hurdle debut in April 2025 but lightly raced and disappointing since; positives can be drawn from last month's reappearance sixth at Southwell (3m, good) but he needs to have come on for the run.
runners.comment: Positives can be drawn from last month's reappearance run but he needs a step forward here
runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson
